Attribute refers to the type of computer file a Digimon represents. There are five different possible attributes:
Vaccine (Va), Virus (Vi), Data (Da), None (No), and Unknown (Un)
Attributes directly influence each other during a battle, giving advantages and disadvantages to Digimon.
None (No) is weak against all other Attributes.
Unknown (Un) is strong against all other Attributes.
Knowing how Attributes interact with each other can be the key between success and failure!
But you can also keep an eye on the arrows next to your partner's Attribute in your battle interface as a reminder.
All right! I'll explain you everything!
The green bar corresponds to Health Points (HP) of your Digimon. it is the amount of life your partner has in battle, before being defeated.
your Digimon'll automatically heal when you stay here in the Lodging, so if you lose a fight, a little rest here is all they will need!
The blue bar corresponds to your Partner's experience points (Xp). It is the measure of progress that indicates how close your Digimon is to gaining a new level.
Earn Xp by defeating opponents! But be careful, losing a battle causes your Digimon to lose a bit of Xp.
The Attack stat determines how much physical damage your Digimon can inflict on an opponent.
While the Defense stat indicates the Digimon's ability to resist or reduce physical damage taken during a battle.
Sp.Attack and Sp.Defense work much like Attack and Defense, but they determine damage and resistance of ranged attacks instead.
The Spirit stat indicates your Digimon's ability to recover from being stunlocked after receiving an attack.
The higher their Spirit, the faster your Digimon will be able to get back into the fight.
The friendship between you and your Digimon partner will determine how quickly you can give it commands during a battle.
The higher your Friendship, the faster they will accept your commands.
Increase the Friendship between you two by winning battles and patting your Digimon sometimes. Just don't pet them too much, otherwise they may get angry.
Age determines, as the name implies, the lifespan of your Digimon. The first number is your Digimon's current age, and the second number is the maximum age it can reach.
Digimon age over time, and when they reach the limit of their lifespan, they go through the ReBorn process.
However since you chose to install the modification to prevent Digimon from passing on, you don't need to worry about Age.
You already know how Hunger works. Your Digimon will warn you when they are hungry, but you can keep track of how hungry they are here.
The same applies to Health. Here you'll be able to see if your Digimon is sick, or injured.

The Pomumon managed to escape RedVegiemon's greed, but you should go talk to him...
After losing his ''fruits'', RedVegiemon decides to go to Log-In Village to open a simpler business.
Golemon is always distracted by his rocks, but he loves to chat about his interests. Can you hold a conversation with him?
Golemon loves rocks and minerals. You should talk to him about it.
Delighted with your idea of ​​opening a quarry, Golemon sets off to Log-In Village.
There's a Digimon in need of help in the Sizzling Desert! Without the strength to leave that place, Drimogemon asks for a simple snack in order to regain his strength.
Find 1 bottle of DigiWater and 1 Deluxe Mushroom to help Drimogemon regain his strength.
Drimogemon managed to get out of the desert! Meet him in the village to find out how he will return the favor.
There's a sad, friendless Digimon in the Village of Beginnings. There must be something you can do to cheer it up.
Bring a snack that might cheer Koromon up. Maybe you'll find something in the Village of Beginnings?
With a full belly and a new friend, Koromon happily sets off for Log-In Village.
There's a curious Digimon in the Dina Plains. Is it true that there are hidden items in small spots that sometimes appear? It's up to you to find out.
Look for small things like patches of grass and tap them to see what happens.
So it's true! There are hidden items in small natural spots in the Digital World!
Betamon wants to test your fishing skills. Accept the challenge and show what you're capable of!
Catch 10 fish in Dina Plains without leaving the map or entering battles.
Now in the village, Betamon can help you keep track of your fish.
Face and defeat V-dramon in Wave Coast.
V-dramon went to Log-In Village. Even without really knowing what he's going to do there.
Chibimon is hurt! You need to help him heal.
Chibimon is hurt! He got separated from his friend Minomon when they were both attacked by a group of evil Digimon. You need to help them heal.
Give Chibimon 1 Bandage to heal its wounds.
Chibimon is healed and heading to Log-In Village, but he asks you to find his friend Minomon!
Minomon is badly hurt! He needs some Healing Syrup to get better!
Chibimon and Minomon are safely reunited in the village. What does the future hold for these two?
They say secrets are worth gold, but it seems Dracumon takes that quite literally! He demands three Golden Acorns in exchange for a valuable secret.
Golden Acorns are rare, but they grow on trees. Perhaps you'll find them in the Digital World.
Looks like this peculiar Digimon wants to be your friend, but something about it feels different. It's huge! A great story is about to begin!
This Koromon doesn't seem to know how to talk to you. You should find it in more places.
The joy of becoming your friend caused Koromon to digivolve! Now he wants to test his newfound strength.
Is there a new location marked on your map? You should go visit it.
Agumon is training to surpass you. Try to find him in the Digital World again.
Agumon suggests a new battle! Fight him again.
Agumon's confidence seems to be wavering... It's best to search for him in the Digital World once more.
Even though he seems a little shaken, Agumon insists on overcoming you. Fight him again.
The villagers seem to have seen a strange Digimon in the forest. You should go talk to them.
Frustration seems to be affecting Agumon. You'd better find him! Look for him in the Digital World.
Agumon Digivolved! He seems stronger, and more spiteful too. He demands a new fight.
The villagers seem worried about something. You should go talk to them.
It seems Greymon was seen heading towards the Mecha Plant. You should go investigate.
Things seems to be getting worst. Go to Log-In Village and warn the residents about the danger.
Greymon is out of control, he needs to be stopped! Go to Server City and put an end to this!
Engulfed in rage, your former friend is now a MetalGreymon! Defeating him is the only option.
Greymon sets off in search of a way to apologize for his mistakes. Hina seems to need help.
A capricious Digimon demands that you find mushrooms for it, and it doesn't seem willing to wait. Since you didn't have much of a choice, you'd better see what this is all about.
The requirement is that you find Deluxe Mushrooms. Deliver 5 of them to Mushmon.
What does ''special mushroom business'' mean? You'd better head over to Server City to find out.
Wandering through the diverse realms of the Digital World, this Digimon seems to be seeking to understand how elemental forces work.
Wizardmon seemed focused. Perhaps he went somewhere else in the Digital World?
Eventually, he should stop and talk to you. Keep searching for Wizardmon in the Digital World.
Wizardmon has gone to Server City. Find him there and see what else he can teach you.
The ruthless Kimeramon has been spotted in Chrome Mines! He looks ready to fight, but... something seems off about it.
It seems Kimeramon didn't want to fight! When he shows up, talk to him.
Happy to be able to be himself, Kimeramon goes to the city in search of fulfilling his dream.
Oh no, there's a Digimon fallen into the Slippery Swamp! However, it doesn't seem too worried about anything at the moment. Is he drinking something?
Nanimon seems ''busy'' right now. You should focus on other things. Maybe he'll recover eventually.
Nanimon heads to Server City. Stop by and find out what he's selling before he gets drunk again!
The mighty Paildramon waits patiently at Wave Coast. At the right moment, he will judge you ready and test your strength.
You should focus on other things. Perhaps Paildramon will consider you ready at some point.
Overcome the challenge of defeating Paildramon with only 1/5 of your HP.
Paildramon has deemed you worthy of the power of Jogress Evolution. Go to Server City If you want to talk to him.
This odd-colored Flymon seems to be looking for someone strong. If you can prove yourself, he'll let you in on a sweet little secret; if you can give him a sour treat first.
You should focus on other things. Maybe if you defeat a powerful opponent, Flymon will talk to you.
Meet Flymon in the city to learn more about the Leader Digimon and their special skills.
An esteemed collector wants to get his hands on the rare, Giant Black Pearl, something only produced by an Ultimate-level Syakomon. But... those don't exist, do they?
Find a Giant Black Pearl for Elecmon. Perhaps you'll find one while exploring the Digital World.
Apparently, the myth of the Ultimate-level Syakomon was true! Take the pearl to Elecmon (Violet).
Elecmon plans to use the pearl to finance his business. Stop by the city to check out the new store.
This totally bulky bro is trying to make sure he gives Server City his best impression. But you can't show off how fit you are if your muscles ain't glistening!
Come back when you have the right items in your inventory. Perhaps another type of oil will also work.
With his muscles glistening, your new ''bro'' is heading to the city to put together a workout session for you.
The sheriff's found a strange anomalous entity pretending to be a Digimon, go take it out for him before it gets too out of hand! He may even offer you a reward or two for your services.
Starmon is now in Server City. Find him there once you've defeated some Glitches.
These two best friends seem quite self-assured and confident that they're better than you. However, something doesn't seem right about them...
Face and defeat LadyDevimon in the Clear Oasis. If they leave, they'll likely return in a few minutes.
They both regretted their actions. Perhaps you will meet them again somewhere in the Digital World.
Beautymon opens a Beauty Salon in town. Now you can change the Skin of some Digimon!
With the city safe again, Shortmon wants to reopen the bakery in Server City, but first she needs to convince her boss, Weddinmon.
Find and talk to Weddinmon. You should search for her in the Digital World.
Weddinmon becomes convinced that it is safe to return to Server City to reopen her bakery shop.
Give 25 DigiWood and 15 DigiStone to Weddinmon.
The city's bakery has been rebuilt! You'll have access to a wide variety of useful cakes.
Meramon stands lost in thought before the lava river of Magma Mountain. What kind of inspiration is he seeking?
You should focus on other things. Perhaps completing something fire-related will catch Meramon's attention?
Face and defeat Meramon in Magma Mountain.
With his inspiration rekindled, Chef Meramon returns to Server City to reopen the restaurant.
The restaurant is in ruins! Bring 30 DigiBoulders to help with the reconstruction.
With the restaurant up and running again, Meramon will be able to make a variety of useful and delicious dishes.
There's a Digimon on the Wave Coast that considers itself majestic. It looks like someone important, which implies he won't talk to just anyone.
You should bring a Digimon partner that looks like Xiquemon. Maybe then he will talk to you.
Driven by his ego, Xiquemon goes to Server City to cook as well.
The Burgamon couple wants to open a burger place in Server City, but they're missing one of their key ingredients! Help them find it.
Come back with the right item in your inventory. Maybe it's something related to their appearance?
With the special ingredient, the couple can open their burger place. Go to Server City and talk to them.
Give 5 DigiHardwood and 15 DigiStone to the Burgamon.
The burger place is finally open! You'll now have access to a wide variety of useful burgers.
Citramon is very bothered by the quality of the products sold by RedVegiemon, and therefore decides to go to Server City to open his own market.
Citramon went to the city. You should go talk to him.
Give 10 DigiBoulder and 15 DigiHardwood to Citramon.
With the marketplace now built, you can buy basic power-up foods for your Digimon!
There's a Sukamon passed out in one of the pipes on Sewer Road. It looks like he wants something to eat.
After eating, Sukamon becomes full of energy and attacks! Defeat it!
Without further ado, Sukamon heads to Server City. Will he find something to do?
You've found the elusive DigiSeabass! An endangered species! This feat caught the attention of a specialist on this species, and it seems he wants to talk to you.
You found a very rare fish! There's a Digimon in the Snow Land that wants to talk to you.
Help save the DigiSeabass from extinction! Talk to Gomamon in the city and see how you can help.
A marine life enthusiast who enjoys watching the fish on Wave Coast. He seems to really enjoy talking about marine animals and fishing.
Tell Gekomon that you like fish and see what he has to say.
Answer the quiz about the fish of the Digital World correctly.
After testing your knowledge, Gekomon goes to the city. Stop by and see what he's doing.
From the Hook to the Market
Seadramon wants to open a fishmonger in Server City, but he needs a good fisherman to help him with the initial stock. Do you think you can handle it?
Offer to help Seadramon with the fishing.
Give 1 DigiTilapia, 1 DigiCarp, and 1 Black DigiTrout to Seadramon.
With the first fish secured, Seadramon can now open the fishmonger in town.
Upon hearing that Seadramon has opened a fishmonger in the city, Sangomon concludes that this will be the ideal place for him to sell his fishing bait from now on!
Sangomon will now be permanently located in Server City and will no longer spawn as a wandering merchant.
Craftmon claims to be the right Digimon to obtain high-quality materials, but at the moment he seems to be trying to resolve some pending issue.
You should focus on other things. Maybe Craftmon will ask you for help later.
A Psychemon owes Craftmon money. Find him in Server City and collect the debt!
Take the payment money to Craftmon.
With his debt paid, Craftmon can return to work in his workshop in Server City.
It seems the distinguished Kuwagamon has managed to secure an opportunity to open a permanent establishment in Server City. Now it's much easier to acquire hunting equipment.
From now on, Kuwagamon will be based in the city. Meet him there.
Oh no! Kuwagamon needs materials. Give him 25 DigiHardwood.
With the emporium now built, you'll have access to even more hunting gear!
Chikurimon found abandoned explosives in the Chrome Mines and wants to detonate them for fun. It costs nothing to help, but is it safe?
Give a Regular Torch to one of your Digimon to hold and return to the Chrome Mines.
Luckily, the explosives didn't detonate. Now Chikurimon is in the city. Let's hope he doesn't blow anything up there.
The powerful MetalTyranomon is very proud of her strength. Apparently, she has a secret to being so strong. Will she share it?
You should focus on other things. Maybe training more will make MetalTyranomon notice you?
Face and defeat MetalTyranomon in Drive Savanna.
In order to create more powerful opponents, MetalTyranomon opens a DigiClone shop in the city.
You found a Ludomon missing all of his armor in Dina Plains. The poor kid is terrified without it! Where could his armor be?
Find Ludomon's armor. You should search the Digital World.
Zubamon had his brother's armor! He went to Server City to return it.
The brothers Ludomon and Zubamon have made peace! Ludomon now works with defensive equipment.
It appears what started out as a harmless joke spiraled out of control, and Zubamon was too scared to apologize to his brother.
With a little encouragement, Zubamon heads to the city determined to return the armor to Ludomon.
The brothers Ludomon and Zubamon have made peace! Zubamon now works with offensive equipment.
There's a medical emergency in Drive Savanna! A Triceramon is suffering from severe food poisoning and, if not treated within two hours, will not survive. We don't have much time!
You have 2 hours! Give 20 DigiHerbs, 1 Froggy Thermometer, and 1 Rainbow Soup to Medicmon.
You managed to save Triceramon! Meet Medicmon in Server City.
You couldn't save Triceramon... Meet Medicmon in Server City.
The civil engineer responsible for several projects in the Digital World. Maybe he can sort out the mess that was left in Server City.
Groundramon still needs to resolve an outstanding issue. You should look for him in the Digital World.
With Groundramon in the city, the debris will soon be removed, and new Digimon may be interested in returning.
Yatagaramon is searching for his lost inspiration. Perhaps if he could catch a glimpse of the same Digimon that inspired him in the past, his creativity would return!
Bring a Digimon from the main evolutionary line of Examon so that Yatagaramon can regain its inspiration.
Server City now boasts a beautiful statue! Courtesy of the artist DR.Crow!
So Greymon is actually a Boss Digimon? Are there others like him out there? Unravel the mystery of the Boss Digimon while trying to find your friend!
Go to your friend's house and try to find him to talk.
Greymon may not be the only one? Search for clues throughout the Digital World.
Explore the Green Domain, in Dina Plains, and defeat Impmon.
The Boss Digimon has been defeated. You should inform Hina of what you've discovered.
The Boss Digimon has been defeated. Defeat more enemies to progress.
SkullKnightmon has something to reveal. Meet him at Jagged Rocks.
Explore the Ancient Domain, in Jagged Rocks, and find SkullKnightmon.
Face and defeat Drimogemon in the Bottom of the Ancient Domain.
You still haven't found Greymon. Look for him in the Digital World.
Greymon seems confused, but he's not ready to talk yet. You should go talk to Hina.
Greymon seems confused, but he's not ready to talk yet. Defeat more enemies to progress.
Investigate the Boss Digimon in Sizzling Desert.
Face and defeat Devimon in the Sizzling Desert.
Greymon discovers the truth about himself! Search for clues throughout the Digital World.
Explore the Fossil Domain, in Drive Savanna, and look for LadyDevimon.
Face and defeat Guilmon in the Fossil Domain.
Find LadyDevimon's friend who will help you get to the Dark Area.
Face and defeat Anubismon in the Dark Area to progress.
Explore the Shadow Domain, in the Dark Area, and search for the ''Fallen Angel''.
The Fallen Angel was Bagramon, but he's not to blame for the Boss Digimon. You should go talk to Hina.
Hina continues her search for clues. You should do the same. Search for clues throughout the Digital World.
Greymon is still seeking your forgiveness. You should try talking to him. Look for him in the Digital World.
Greymon is in danger! Enter the Frigid Domain, in Snow Land, and rescue your friend!
Face and defeat Devimon in the Frigid Domain and rescue Greymon!
Greymon has been kidnapped! What are Devimon's intentions? Will you be able to rescue your friend?
An injured Digimon! Kudamon was exploring the Link Ruins and ended up hurting himself when he fell. You need to help him!
Kudamon went to Server City. Maybe there he'll find a way to repay your help.
Ropuremon is always looking for a new adventure, and this time it seems he's found a good one!
Ropuremon seems to be preparing for something. Go talk to him.
Where did Ropuremon go? Look for him in the Digital World.
Face and defeat DORUgoramon to rescue Ropuremon!
Go to Server City so Ropuremon can tell you more about the ''Adventure Mode''!
Sweet Sunflowmon looks like she's been having a really bad day, and is having a wild fit down in Chrome Mines. Maybe she'll feel better once she's gotten a battle in her system.
Face and defeat Sunflowmon in Chrome Mines.
Now calmer, Sunflowmon heads to Server City. Maybe she'll find something to do there.
An Appmon who loves all things about getting stronger, he's got just about everything he could want. Everything except for a shiny new Accelerator...!
Happy to have completed his collection, Musclemon heads to the city. You should go see him.
Always doing things too quickly, Monmon didn't realize he was no longer in the forest and dropped his bunches of orange bananas. Now he needs help finding them!
Find the 5 bunches of orange bananas hidden in S. Bridge Valley and talk to Monmon.
Now that he's found his bananas, Monmon will reappear in the Digital World as a wandering merchant.
This time traveler has run out of temporal fuel to continue his journeys. Maybe he will need a little help!
Give 20 DigiLight and 20 DigiNight to Clockmon.
Clockmon managed to travel through time again! Perhaps he will reappear sometime in the future.
Clockmon traveled through time and is now in Server City. Perhaps he came to return the favor.
Gogmamon seems busy. Perhaps he's dealing with some problem, or trying to solve some mystery...
You should focus on other things. Maybe you can help Gogmamon later.
Perhaps you can help solve Gogmamon's problem if you have the right item in your inventory.
Gogmamon was so excited that he went to the city. Maybe you should go find him there.
The Curiosity of the Black Cat
Your victory in the ''Dark Subspecies'' challenge caught BlackTailmon's attention. She seems interested in new opportunities.
BlackTailmon heads to Server City in search of something to do.
There's a treacherous Digimon spreading all sorts of fake news online. Although it seems harmless, misinformation is very dangerous! Stop this Digimon!
Stop Publimon from spreading fake news! If it runs away, it will probably return after a few minutes.
Apparently, after being caught spreading fake news, Publimon fled to Server City.
Angemon, somehow, ends up breaking his Holy Rod after going ham in the world's craziest game of limbo during a house party. Embarrassed, he asks you to help him get a fresh one...
Angemon goes to the city to create new ways to aid in the fight against darkness.
Apparently, there was a NiseDrimogen in the city all this time. He claims to sell high-quality items, but something about that seems very suspicious...
It seems there's a new business in Servidor City. But I think it's best to leave that one alone...
An imposing, wicked Digimon has taken interest in your grandiose feats and challenges you to prove your worth to him in combat. If you can win, he'll offer you a challenge like no other!
Face and defeat VenomMyotismon in Server City.
This vitamin maker is planning to go to the city. However, he's afraid of catching some disease there! Is there any way to convince him that the city is safe?
Convince Supplemon that it's safe to go to Server City. Maybe someone there knows how to convince him.
Follow Aidmon's plan! Go back to the Modular Forest and talk to Supplemon.
Aidmon's plan worked! Supplemon finally went to Server City.
Guilmon seems to know something, but apparently he won't tell you while your Tamer Level is low.
Increase your Tamer Level and talk to Guilmon again.
The secret has been revealed! Now you know how to use your Tamer Skills!

The grand finale is almost here! Discover who's behind the emergence of the Digimon Boss and put an end to this threat to the Digital World, all while trying to rescue Greymon from the clutches of guilt!
Jijimon senses that something is happening in Link Ruins. You'd better go investigate.
The Royal Knights are questioning whether they should trust you. Search for clues throughout the Digital World.
Greymon is in danger! Explore the Processor Domain in Sizzling Desert and save your friend!
Devimon forced Greymon to Digivolve against its will! Face and defeat SkullGreymon in the Processor Domain.
Greymon has been absorbed by Devimon! Face and defeat Ghoulmon to rescue your friend!
Greymon is safe, but the mystery of the Boss Digimon continues. Perhaps Hina has something to say.
Greymon is safe, but the mystery of the Boss Digimon continues. Defeat more enemies to progress.
Search for 3 data fragments scattered throughout the Digital World.
You've found all the data fragments scattered throughout the Digital World. Go talk to Hina.
Hina is deciphering the log messages. You should focus on other things while she works.
Oh no! You need to stop Hina from finishing deciphering the fragmented messages!
It's too late... The ''beings of chaos'' have been awakened. Search for them throughout the Digital World.
Duftmon knows where to find the first Chaos General, but he will only tell you if you defeat him in Magma Mountain.
Explore the Patch Domain and defeat ChaosGreymon, the first Chaos General.
Explore the Mega Domain and defeat ChaosSeadramon, the second Chaos General.
Explore the Data Domain and defeat ChaosPiedmon, the third and final Chaos General.
With the Chaos Generals defeated, what will be the next step? Perhaps someone in the city knows what to do.
Bagramon seems to be your only option. Go to the Dark Area and ask him for help.
A Royal Knight has forbidden VenomMyotismon from taking you to the Dark Area. Find him in Link Ruins.
Dynasmon now thinks you're a threat too! Defeat him in the Link Ruins.
Omegamon recognizes your good will. Go to the Shadow Domain, in the Dark Area, and ask Bagramon for help.
You've been judged an intruder! Face and defeat Dominimon in the Kernel, and go after Greymon!
Explore the Chaos Tower, in the Kernel, and face the ''Ultimate Organism''.
The time has come for the final showdown. Face and defeat Overlord GAIA!
This curious Digimon seems willing to help you with your ReBorn bonuses if you defeat it in battle. Show it what you're capable of!
Use an Ultimate-level Digimon with a ReBorn bonus and defeat Digitamamon in Modular Forest.
Talk to Digitamamon in Server City to see the ReBorn bonuses your Digimon has.
Groundramon is a respected and focused professional, but lately he's been pensive. Perhaps he's worried about something, or someone?
Groundramon seems thoughtful. You should go talk to him.
Enter the Chrome Domain, in Chrome Mines, and find Kenkimon.
Kenkimon is finally back to work! His skills will be very useful from now on.
An adventurer willing to share stories about his adventures and secrets. What kinds of mysteries might he reveal?
You should focus on other things. Perhaps Ropuremon will talk to you later.
You should check your Challenges list. Something about becoming a true ''Dungeon Dweller''.
Ropuremon has revealed the secret of the D-Dungeons to you! New paths are about to open!
Whamon is always happy when someone stops and listens to the sound of the water. He teaches that paying attention to the water can reveal many surprises!
Look for small ripples in the water and tap them to see what happens.
So there are indeed items in small ripples in the water! You'd better keep an eye out for them. Talk to Whamon.
Whamon went looking for something to do. Maybe you'll find him in Log-In Village.
The ogres of the underworld have awakened, and the brave Gaioumon sets out to confront them! Will he be able to put an end to this threat?
Gaioumon seems willing to face the ogre threat. Perhaps you'll meet him again in the future.
Help fight against the ogres! Explore the Ogre Domain and find Gaioumon.
Gaioumon has digivolved! Prove you're a worthy opponent and defeat him in a friendly battle.
Now, Gaioumon: Itto Mode remains vigilant as guardian of the Ogre Domain until the end of time.
The Burgamon have gotten a surprise order from somewhere in Magma Mountain. It's way too hot to deliver the food themselves, so it's up to you to make the delivery.
It seems the Burgamon couple is having a problem! You should go talk to them in Server City.
Explore the Volcanic Domain, in Magma Mountain, and deliver 5 Cyan Pretty Burga Patty.
Angemon has taken a commission that is a bit too much for him to chew at the moment. He requested your aid to make sure it gets to the client on time.
Angemon seems to be having a problem. Talk to him in Server City.
Explore the Empyrean Domain, in Link Ruins, and find Angemon's supplier.
A lovestruck WaruMonzaemon wrote a love letter to his mysterious crush. The problem is, he's too timid to deliver it! Could you help this poor, lovesick teddy bear?
WaruMonzaemon is too timid to give his love letter to his beloved. Could you help him with that?
Explore the Flowery Domain and deliver the love letter to Rafflesimon.
Rafflesimon wants to meet her secret admirer! Hurry and tell WaruMonzaemon the good news!
Starmon has been hearing some noises coming from Mecha Plant lately. He thinks it might be an old acquaintance of his who's been missing for a while. It's worth investigating.
Explore the Mechanical Domain, in Mecha Plant. and discover if the mysterious sound is related to Datamon.
Datamon is out of control! Bypass his security protocols and bring him back to consciousness!
After returning to normal, Datamon heads to the city to continue his research. You should check it out.
Bulkmon wants to expand the city's gym to offer better results for HP training, and a recent achievement of yours caught his attention. Go talk to him and find out how to help your bro!
Bulkmon seems to be looking for someone, and your help would be welcome. Talk to him in Server City.
Explore the Volcanic Domain, in Magma Mountain, and find the cardio expert, Volcamon.
Join Volcamon's cardio workout! Walk through the 11th floor of the Volcanic Domain and reach him!
You managed to convince Volcamon to go to Server City. Go there and talk to Bulkmon.

Penmon longs to taste some Cunning Cod, but he doesn't have the courage to catch one. Legends tell of a fisherman who used to catch these fish. Perhaps, if you find him, he will teach you how to catch one.
Explore the Cold Sea Domain, and find a Cunning Cod for Penmon.
Face and defeat Vikemon in the Cold Sea Domain and learn how to fish for the Cunning Cod.
The old fisherman taught you the secret of catching Cunning Cod. Take one to Penmon.
Penmon is going to Server City to savor his Cunning Cod. You should go talk to him.
The Secret from Another Digital World

Rurimon seems to be looking for something or someone. Do you have what it takes to help this little guy?

Play Digital Heroes 2, by Sette Fan-Games, available for download on Itch.io!!!
Prove to this Digimon that you can help! Face and defeat Rurimon in Server City.
Rurimon didn't say where the meeting point was! Play Digital Heroes 2 to find out!
They say secrets are worth gold, and Dracumon continues to take that quite literally! This time he wants a golden snack. Golden Carps, to be more specific!
Order 5 Golden Carp dishes from Xiquemon and bring them to Dracumon.
A rather odd-looking Bastemon has invited you to come help her find her missing jewelry. How scandalous~ She awaits you in her room. Don't keep her waiting!
A special invitation! Explore the Feline Domain and find Bastemon in her room.
What kind of attitude is that? Anyway... Face and defeat Bastemon in the Feline Domain.
Bastemon seems to be quite... eccentric. Now you can also find her in Server City.
Detective Sangloupmon is on the trail of a vase thief, and he has a lead on where the crook might be! Perhaps you can help find this evildoer.
Explore the Fossil Domain in Drive Savanna and help Sangloupmon find the thief!
Catch the thief! Walk through the 7th floor of the Fossil Domain and find the bandit!
In the end, the thief was never found. Perhaps you'll find answers by talking to someone in the Digital World.
It was all a misunderstanding! At least Drimogemon will now have a better chance of finding more items.

This rowdy little one is enthusiastic to find some help! He's got a whiff mysterious scent, but seems too scatterbrained to figure out where it's coming from. Can you help the poor pooch find the source?
Look for Loogamon in the Digital World. He mentioned Dina Plains, Boot Jungle, and Clear Oasis.
Look for Loogamon in the Digital World. He mentioned Mecha Plant, Palette Amazon, and Chrome Mines.
This time Loogamon ran off without saying exactly where he was going. Look for him in the Digital World.
Face and defeat Helloogarmon in Magma Mountain.
Loogamon ran off again without saying where he was going. Look for him in the Digital World.
Face and defeat Fenriloogamon in Snow Land.
Loogamon found the mysterious scent! Now he's heading to Server City. You should go talk to him.
Tanemon!!! Are you alright? I was so worried about you!
I'm okay, Palmon! Thanks to this tamer and their Digimon, I'm safe now.
Thank you so much for saving my sister. I don't know what I would have done without you. You truly are a hero.
We should go somewhere safer now.
I heard Jijimon went back to Log-In Village. Maybe we should go there too.
Come on, Tanemon. Let's go to Log-In Village. We'll find something to do there, I'm sure of it. And most importantly, we'll be together and safe.
Yeah, let's go to Log-In Village! I want to help too!
Tanemon!!! Você está bem? Eu estava tão preocupada com você!
Estou bem, Palmon! Graças a esse Domador e seu Digimon, estou a salvo agora.
Muito obrigada por salvar minha irmã. Não sei o que teria feito sem você. Você é realmente um herói.
Nós deveriamos ir para um lugar mais seguro agora.
Fiquei sabendo que Jijimon voltou para a Vila Log-In. Talvez nós também devessemos ir para lá.
Vamos lá, Tanemon. Vamos para a Vila Log-In. Temos certeza de que encontraremos algo para fazer lá. E o mais importante, estaremos juntas e em segurança.

Atributo se refere ao tipo de arquivo de computador que um Digimon representa. Existem cinco Atributos diferentes possíveis:
Vacina (Va), Vírus (Vi), Dados (Da), Nenhum (No), e Desconhecido (Un)
Os Atributos influenciam diretamente uns aos outros durante uma batalha, conferindo vantagens e desvantagens aos Digimon.
Nenhum (No) é fraco contra todos os outros Atributos..
Desconhecido (Un) é forte contra todos os outros Atributos.
Entender como os Atributos interagem entre si pode ser a chave entre o sucesso e o fracasso!
Mas você também pode ficar de olho nas setas ao lado do Atributo do seu parceiro na interface de batalha como um lembrete.
Muito bem! Vou te explicar tudo!
A barra verde corresponde aos Pontos de Vida (PV) do seu Digimon. Ela representa a quantidade de vida que seu parceiro tem em batalha, antes de ser derrotado.
Seu Digimon se cura automaticamente enquanto estiver nessa sala, então, se você perder uma luta, um pouco de descanso aqui é tudo o que ele vai precisar!
A barra azul corresponde aos pontos de experiência (Xp) do seu parceiro. Ela mede o progresso do seu Digimon e indica o quão perto ele está de subir de nível.
Ganhe XP derrotando oponentes! Mas cuidado, perder uma batalha faz com que seu Digimon perca um pouco de XP.
O atributo Ataque determina quanto dano físico seu Digimon pode infligir a um oponente.
Enquanto o atributo Defesa indica a capacidade do Digimon de resistir ou reduzir o dano físico recebido durante uma batalha.
AtaqueEsp. e DefesaEsp. funcionam de forma muito semelhante ao Ataque e a Defesa, mas determinam o dano e a resistência de ataques à distância.
O atributo Espírito indica a capacidade do seu Digimon de se recuperar de um atordoamento após receber um ataque.
Quanto maior o Espírito do seu Digimon, mais rápido ele poderá voltar a lutar.
A Amizade entre você e seu parceiro Digimon determinará a rapidez com que você poderá dar comandos a ele durante uma batalha.
Quanto maior for o seu nível de Amizade, mais rápido ele aceitará suas ordens.
Aumente a Amizade entre vocês dois vencendo batalhas e acariciando seu Digimon de vez em quando. Só não o acaricie demais, senão ele pode ficar bravo.
A idade determina a expectativa de vida do seu Digimon. O primeiro número representa a idade atual e o segundo número representa a idade máxima que ele pode atingir.
Os Digimon envelhecem com o tempo e, quando atingem o limite de sua expectativa de vida, passam pelo processo de ReNascer.
No entanto, como você optou por instalar a modificação para impedir que os Digimon morram, você não precisa se preocupar com a idade.

O mesmo se aplica à Saúde. Aqui você poderá ver se seu Digimon está doente ou ferido.

Olá, meu jovem! Sou Jijimon, um velho e sábio Digimon. Mas, apesar disso, encontro-me numa situação bastante peculiar...
Por muitos anos viajei por todo canto do Mundo Digital. Por mais anos do que eu gostaria de admitir! Hohohoho!
Mas infelizmente, já não sou mais tão jovem para continuar essas viagens intermináveis. Acho que chegou a hora de voltar para minha vila natal.
Temo que minha velha memória tenha deletado alguns dados e talvez eu não me lembre bem do caminho de casa. Hohohoho!
No entanto, acredito que com uma ajudinha eu conseguirei me lembrar do caminho de volta para casa.
O que você me diz, meu jovem? Você ajudaria um velho Digimon a voltar para casa?
Ó meu jovem, você mudou de ideia? Vai ajudar um velho Digimon a encontrar o caminho de casa?
Au! Au! Olá amigo viajante! Eu sou Komondomon, um andarilho do Mundo Digital. Minha paixão é desbravar todos os cantos do mundo e encontrar novos companheiros de viagem!
Au! Minhas patas já trilharam muitos caminhos, e forjei muitas conexões com diversos Digimon! Au! Au!
E depois de viajar tanto, eu tive uma ideia muito brilhante! Au! Au!
Minha ideia é criar uma agência de viagens! Isso mesmo! Au! Au! Uma agência de viagens que possa conectar vários lugares do mundo!
Só a ideia de facilitar a movimentação dos Digimon por todo o Mundo Digital já me enche de alegria! Au! Au!
O problema é que eu não sei onde eu poderia abrir tal agência... Snif... Snif...

Ribbit... How embarrassing. I guess you're not as mighty as I thought. Come back if you ever wanna try again.
(I can't believe how lucky I was to win! Hope this Tamer go away before they notice my little fibs...)
Ribbit... Parece que eu te subestimei, Domador... Quer dizer... Você venceu desta vez, MAS só porque... Porque eu estava distraído! Isso! Eu estava distraído.
(Quem eu estou tentando enganar? Foi um milagre eu ter sobrevivido! Esse Domador me deu uma baita surra!)
Ribbit... Que vergonha. Acho que você não é tão poderoso quanto eu pensava. Volte se quiser tentar de novo.
(Não acredito na sorte que tive de ganhar! Espero que esse Domador desapareça antes que percebam meus blefes...)
I have survived many fierce battles, and yet I lost... You have proven yourself worthy. I concede defeat.
You may pass, but remember, the dangers of Drive Savanna are not to be taken lightly.
Hmph, you were not strong enough. Retreat for now, but do not forget the lesson you've learned today. Strength and discipline are paramount in Drive Savanna.
Sobrevivi a muitas batalhas ferozes, e ainda assim perdi... Você provou ser digno. Admito a derrota.
Você pode passar, mas lembre-se: os perigos da Savana Condutora não devem ser subestimados.
Hum, você não foi forte o suficiente. Recue por enquanto, mas não se esqueça da lição que aprendeu hoje. Força e disciplina são fundamentais na Savana Condutora.
Your soul is strong and your spirit virtuous. Your willpower shall illuminate your path through the Chrome Mines.
Darkness shall devour your soul if you descend into the Chrome Mines with such feeble spirit. Return when you can confront the ghosts that await you there.
Sua alma é forte e seu espírito virtuoso. Sua força de vontade iluminará seu caminho pelas Minas de Cromo.
A escuridão devorará sua alma se você descer às Minas de Cromo com tão pouco espírito. Retorne quando puder enfrentar os fantasmas que lá o aguardam.
Your heart shines with purity, and your strength has proven worthy.
You may pass, knowing that the light of Angewomon will guide your journey through the sacred Link Ruins.
Even in defeat, there is a chance for redemption. Reflect on your actions and seek to purify your heart. My light will always be there to guide you towards righteousness.
Seu coração irradia pureza, e sua força se provou digna.
Você pode prosseguir, sabendo que a luz de Angewomon guiará sua jornada pelas sagradas Ruínas Hyperlink.
Mesmo na derrota, há uma chance de redenção. Reflita sobre suas ações e busque purificar seu coração. Minha luz sempre estará lá para guiá-lo ao rumo certo.
Ugh, Numemon not feeling so good. You win this time. Numemon grant you access to Sewer Road.
Ha! You see? Numemon not so easy to beat, huh? You think you tough, but Numemon tougher!
Ugh, Numemon não se sentindo muito bem. Você vence desta vez. Numemon concede acesso à Estrada do Esgoto.
Ah! Você vê? Numemon não tão fácil de derrotar, né? Você se achar durão, mas Numemon mais durão!
System compromised. Subject assigned as safe. Access to Mecha Plant granted. You can proceed now.
Intruder detected. Threat neutralized. Initiating self-repair protocols. The subject retreat is advised.
Sistema comprometido. Indivíduo considerado seguro. Acesso à Fábrica Mecânica concedido. Pode prosseguir agora.
Intruso detectado. Ameaça neutralizada. Iniciando protocolos de autorreparo. Recomenda-se que o indivíduo se retire.
Unbelievable... You blew me out like a little candle. I must yield to your strength. Go forth, traveler, and may the flames of victory light your path through Sizzling Desert.
The fires of GeoGreymon burn eternal. Remember this defeat, for it shall fuel your determination to become stronger.
Inacreditável... Você me apagou como uma velinha. Devo me render à sua força. Siga em frente, e que as chamas da vitória iluminem seu caminho pelo Deserto Ardente.
As chamas de GeoGreymon ardem eternamente! Lembre-se desta derrota, pois ela alimentará sua determinação em se tornar mais forte.
Grr... You may have won this round weakling, but remember, MegaloGrowmon's might is eternal! Humpf... You may proceed to Magma Mountain...
Pathetic weakling! You are not worthy to stand before the might MegaloGrowmon! Retreat, and know that your defeat is absolute!
Grr... Você pode ter vencido dessa vez, fracote, mas lembre-se, o poder de MegaloGrowmon é eterno! Humpf... Vai logo pra Montanha de Magma...
Fracote patético! Você não é digno de enfrentar o poderoso MegaloGrowmon! Recue, e saiba que sua derrota é absoluta!
Impressive... After all these years, I had never faced such a challenge. Seems like I still have more to learn...
You have proven yourself worthy of diving into the depths of Net Ocean.
You have underestimated my prowess in battle! Despite my age, my combat skills remain sharp as ever.
Impressionante... Depois de todos esses anos, nunca havia enfrentado um desafio como esse. Parece que ainda tenho algo para aprender...
Você provou ser digno de mergulhar nas profundezas do Oceano Net.
Você subestimou minha destreza em batalha! Apesar da minha idade, minhas habilidades de combate permanecem afiadas como sempre.
Wow champ, you fight like a true champion! You'll be fine in Palette Amazon. I'll grant you passage!
Wow, champ! This time I got the best of it! But don't give up! You need to be strong to survive in Palette Amazon.
Uau, campeão, você luta como um verdadeiro campeão! Você se dará bem na Paleta Amazônica. Vou lhe conceder passagem!
Uau, campeão! Dessa vez eu me saí melhor! Mas não desista! Você precisa ser forte para sobreviver na Paleta Amazônica.

I'll meet you at the Network Lodging when you're done!
seems to be ready to Digivolve. Select the desired evolution and meet me at the Network Lodging once you are ready.

A Digital Monster that was born just recently. On the surface of its slime-shaped body, it has grown thick, black fuzz. It is unable to battle as it has just been born, but it can produce bubble-like objects from its mouth to intimidate the enemy.

A small Digimon which grew in size, the downy hair that covered his body falling out as he did so. He is able to lively move about, but he still cannot fight yet. He appears and threatens the enemy by producing bubbles.

A Reptile Digimon that has grown up into a being that can walk on two feet. It has a ferocious personality, but is also very brave and reliable. Although it is fearless, because its body is still in the middle of growing up, it bears a weak amount of power.

A Reptile Digimon which has grown up and become able to walk on two legs, it has an appearance like a tiny dinosaur. Because it is still on the way to adulthood, its power is low, but as its personality is quite ferocious, it doesn't understand fear. It has grown hard, sharp claws on its hands and feet, and demonstrates its power in battle. It is also a being that foretells evolution to a great and powerful Digimon.

A Dinosaur Digimon whose cranial skin has hardened so that it is covered in a rhinoceros beetle-like shell. It is an extremely aggressive Digimon, with a body like a lethal weapon covered in sharp claws and gigantic horns. However, it is highly intelligent, and if you're able to tame it then there probably isn't any monster as strong.

A unique Digimon whose whole body is made up of unique plastic blocks. It is said that a child playing on the Internet created it to resemble Agumon's appearance, and so it is very cute. Unlike the confident Agumon, it has a cowardly side, and its blocks fall apart when it is surprised. However, it possesses a heart of justice that cannot turn a blind eye to evil. Also, it absolutely loves children, and enjoys communicating with them over the Net.

A new species of Digimon that was discovered recently. As a survivor of a species that flourished in the Genesis of the Digital World, it is able to perform ''Armor evolution'', a ''pseudo-evolution'' using the Digimentals. Among others, V-mon is an excellent Combat Species, as it possesses hidden power, and demonstrates tremendous abilities by Armor evolving. Although it has a mischievous, prank-loving personality, it has another side with a strong sense of justice.

A separate species of Agumon that inhabits snowy fields. Due to the mischievousness it inherited from Agumon, it is always happily excited like a child when it snows. Because the color of its body is identical to that of snow, in battle it is able to approach the enemy to attack without being exposed.

A tiny Digimon with limb-like protrusions growing beneath its body (head?). Baby Digimon that have grown limbs are extremely rare, and their appearance is enormously cute. However, caution should be taken in reaching out to it with one's hand just because of its cuteness, as it will suddenly open its mouth wide and bite with the fangs growing closely packed within. Having said that, it bears no ill will and has a very innocent personality.

A small-sized Digimon capable of flying at low altitudes using the ear-like parts growing from its head. It is able to move those ears skillfully and use them like hands, performing gestures such as pulling its eyelid and sticking its tongue out, or slapping its rear to mock the opponent. It has a prank-loving personality. It will bully Digimon such as Koromon or Tunomon by chasing them around.

A Digimon fused from the data of small, pet animals like dogs and cats. Because its unexpected movements are also quick, caution is necessary so that it doesn't get away, but it becomes very emotionally attached if shown affection like a pet.

A Chick Digimon that always runs about restlessly. Because it expresses its emotions in how it runs, it doesn't stand still unless it is a time when it is bored or sleeping. Because its emotions do not appear on its face, its emotions must be read from how it runs, so it is a Digimon with which making a connection is very difficult. Although Pinamon hates its tails being touched, because a miniature electric shock is generated from the tails, more caution is needed when touching its tails than with Puwamon.

A Mammal Digimon characterized by its large ears. It is able to fly through the air by using them as large wings, but because it only goes at a speed of 1 km/h, it is said that it is definitely faster walking. However, it's very popular because its appearance is cute when it is desperately flying (though it seems that it doesn't feel the same). Also, even though Patamon doesn't wear a Holy Ring, it is able to exhibit its hidden holy power, and it appears to have inherited the genes of ancient Digimon.

With one horn growing from its head, it is a Digimon shrouded in mystery. It can be classified as a Beast Digimon from its body structure, but it's still not understood what kind of evolved form it will take on. Also, it is rumored that it is sometimes born with a twin. It's a very cute type of Digimon, and from its calm behavior it doesn't seem like a ''Combat Species'' Digimon, but in the case of battle, it shows that it is more powerful than it appears.

Said to have descended to the ancient Digital World long ago, it is an Angel Digimon which has the appearance of a child. It manifested in an era in which the Digital World was still chaotic, and it is said that it brought about order and harmony. However, a long period of darkness was summoned due to Lucemon's later ''Rebellion''. It is said that Lucemon's abilities have now been inherited and split among the Three Archangels.

A Mammal Digimon with large, sharp claws. It has an extremely aggressive temperament despite its small size, and it never warms up to humans. Although the claws on its forelegs are very effective at attacking, they are also surprisingly suited to digging holes, which it always does as it enjoys watching other Digimon fall into its pitfalls due to its mischievous personality.

It resembles Patamon in appearance, but its personality is a total opposite. A rather twisted creature, it acts as a familiar for Devimon and others. Having a personality that makes it prone to brawl, it attempts to settle things down with a fight immediately.

A mischief-loving, impish Digimon with the appearance of a small oni. Cunning but lacking courage, it never acts alone; instead, it always attacks in groups while hiding in the shadows of trees or buildings. However, once outnumbered, they run away at full speed just like baby spiders dispersing. Whether to make up for it, its intelligence is a little higher than other Child Digimon.

A tiny familiar Digimon which has the appearance of a bat. It exists to serve as a familiar for higher-class Digimon like Devimon and Vamdemon, but it is also said to be the one responsible for tempting Devimon, who was an angel-species Digimon, and luring it to the Dark Side. Although its offensive ability and the like are not strong, it is cunning and makes mischief all over. It prefers the dark, and is often with a higher-level Digimon at all times, so it seems that it is seldom observed on its own.

It loves pranks, so it enjoys seeing the embarrassed appearances of its opponents. Also, it is said that when Impmon appears, electrical appliances temporarily go crazy, so an electronic image going out of order or ceasing to function might be because Impmon was pulling a prank. Although it is a Digimon that loves mischief and malice, it never toadies to the strong, but stands up to them with a strong attitude. However, the truth is that it has a lonely side.

An ancient, pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that is said to be the ''Progenitor'' of all Dramon-type Digimon. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build, and both its power and its quick wits are top class among Child Digimon. It has a nature whose primary trait is wanting to collect 'shiny things', with an especially strange attachment to gems and metals, and it eats and assimilates its favorite things.

An extremely precious twin Digimon Child. Terriermon is the one with one horn growing from its head, while Lopmon is the one with three horns growing from its head. The way it grows is shrouded in mystery, and though it can be classified as a Beast-species Digimon from its body structure, aside from that it is still not understood. Terriermon has a calm personality, but is very robust. In contrast, Lopmon has the personality of a lonely crybaby.

A Beast Digimon that is thought to be a subspecies of the Gazimon-species that grew pointed claws. With its keen movements, it specializes in ''Hit and Away'' attacks. The gloves on its hands appear to protect its claws until they are fully grown.

A Beast Digimon that is, because of the outdated Interface on its brow, presumed to be an experimental ''Prototype Digimon'' from before Digimon were discovered. it often barks and bites at everything as a result of its high combat instinct, though it apparently feels a sense of attachment to something after biting it.

A Holy Beast Digimon that wears a holy cartridge case. It is said that day after day, it accumulates holy power within the earring on its left ear, and that the stored power is great enough to have influence on its next evolution. It has a calm, cool, and collected personality, conducting a precise assessment of the situation even in combat, and attaining the advantage in battle. Conversely, when it gets outnumbered, it possesses a defensive technique in which it goes into its cartridge and settles down.

A Digimon that was transformed into a half-beast, half-man form when Wolfmon's power was halved. Because it has not lost its ''Combat Instinct'', unlike the similar half-beast, half-man Flamon, it has a ferocious side. For that reason, although it has the appearance of a Child Digimon, it will sometimes rampage enough to be out of control even for the typical Adult. As with Flamon, although its power was decreased, it seems that Adult-class Digimon aren't a match for it.

A subspecies of Falcomon whose wings have developed to allow it to fly freely in the air, in contrast to normal Falcomon, who possess powerful leg strength. Despite its ability to fly, it seems to be obsessed with making its appearance from above by flying in on a kite, like a ninja.

A Mammal Digimon that retained Tsunomon's mammal-like elements and evolved. It's very curious and lively, and inherited its prank-loving personality from Tunomon. Also, Elecmon possesses nine tails, and during battle, it fans out its tail like the plumage of a peacock to intimidate its opponent.

A Chick Digimon whose wings have developed to become like arms. It is able to dexterously operate its wings and use them to grip objects, but for that reason, it is poor at flying in the air. It usually lives on the ground, but when danger draws near it escapes by flying away. However, since its flying ability is on the same level as Patamon, it sees Patamon as its rival.

A Tropical Fish Digimon with a brightly colored body. It inhabits and forms schools within the warm coral reefs right below the equator. Using its large fins, it is able to fly above the ocean's surface for short periods, and the sight of a school of Swimmon elegantly flying about the surface of the ocean is counted as one of the Digital World's three most scenic views.

An Ore Digimon that is clad in ore data from the fields that has high defenses. With its mischievous and cheerful personality, it brings low generation Digimon along with it as if it were a bully, and is a live wire that jumps about in the system. It is sometimes a bit selfish, and once it is angered, it goes on a violent rampage like a volcanic eruption, becoming unstoppable.

A Digimon that resembles an ancient dinosaur that existed in the prehistoric world. It sweeps everything away with its two well-developed arms and its gigantic tail. It is extremely easy to tame due to its intelligence and docile personality. For that reason, it is highly valued by beginner Tamers, and is often raised with care. You could probably say that it is a representative figure of the most basic Digimon.

A repulsive, poop-shaped Digimon that shines golden. It was born from the accumulation and mutation of scrap data thrown into the recycle bin of a computer desktop. It likes dark places, and being a pile of scrap data, it is similar to Numemon in that it is often hated by other Digimon. Its intelligence and offensive ability are nonexistent.

A Virus attribute Greymon with a bluish-black body. While it has been called a 'feral Greymon', befitting its more violent disposition, it is in no way a lone wolf and possesses enough intelligence to work together with its allies as a team.

A unique Digimon that is conjectured to be a subspecies of Greymon. Its entire body as well as the carapace on its head have also developed to become like lethal weapons, giving it a more aggressives appearance.

As its huge horn grows, it becomes large enough to account for half of its body length. Monochromon can be said to be a Digimon that excels in both offense and defense. It is herbivorous and has a relatively docile personality, but once it is angered, it will continue to unleash terrifying counterattacks from its heavy tank-like body.

A Flame Digimon whose entire body is shrouded in crimson flames. As a Digimon generated from the defensive ''Firewall'' which prevents illegal entries from the Internet and the like, it possesses a violent temperament like the flames that envelop its body, and tries to incinerate everything it touches. Its fire power is stronger than those of the same species on File Island, and because taming this Digimon is extremely difficult, even if it's tamed, there's no telling when it will bare its fangs.

A Planet Digimon that was accidentally discovered within planet-analyzing software at a space development center. It is a space warrior equipped with a star-shaped armor suit, and star-marked gloves and boots. Its tattered yellow scarf indicates Starmon's combat experience. The eyes at the center of its body are burning with fighting spirit, and are able to convey its will to the opponent without even saying a word. In addition, it can also hypnotize the opponent as an advanced way of using them.

A Machine Digimon that protects the Computer Network's defensive wall. Originally, it was a Digimon that repelled anyone illegally entering the Network's defensive wall. However, a malicious hacker who noticed its ironclad defensive ability infected Guardromon with a computer virus, and used it to protect themselves from the ''Virus Busters''. Basically, since Guardromon only has ''Defense'' program commands, it does not pose a huge problem as long as it can defend against intruders.

A mythical Ancient Species Digimon that, even with the vastness of the Digital World, is said to only exist on the Folder Continent. Its existence is extremely rare, and even on the Folder Continent, it is hardly encountered. With the exception of it becoming known as V-dramon due to the ''V''-shaped pattern on its chest, its way of life is a mystery, but for some reason, it is always mistaken for a dog.

An Adult-level Mythical Dragon Digimon that attained V-mon's natural power and evolved. XV-mon is a purebreed of V-dramon, and it is said that the variant species is V-dramon. The attacks it unleashes using its developed arm and leg strength are tremendous, and are powerful enough to destroy a mountain of rock without leaving a trace. It is feared because it possesses such destructive power, but in reality, it has a strong sense of justice, and will not use that power recklessly.

A Mythical Beast Digimon that grew gigantic wings. It's a highly valued monster due to it being said to have an existence close to that of a god. It specializes in mid-air attacks, its roar calls forth storms, and it causes giant tornadoes by flapping its wings. Its personality is considerably brutal, but it has great intelligence. However, being employed by an ordinary Tamer doesn't seem possible.

An Aquatic Digimon that has a long, serpentine body. Using its long body, it wreathes itself around approaching enemies and constricts them until they are suffocated. It did not have any intelligence to begin with, and it swims around the Net Ocean, wherever its instincts take it.

An Ice-snow Digimon whose body is covered in snow and ice crystals. Contrary to its cold appearance, it has a very warm, gentle personality. As a Digimon that melts the hearts of those who see it with its calm movements and sweet behavior, Yukidarumon hates fighting by nature. Among the battle-loving Digimon, it dreads Meramon in particular.

A ghost Digimon completely covered by a cloth over its head. As it is a wicked being born from darkness, it is said that computers possessed by Bakemon instantly have their systems destroyed. Everything within the cloth is wrapped in mystery, and it is rumored that a portion of the shadow of its true form has become a black hole. It dislikes direct attacks because its fighting strength isn't great.

A Fallen Angel Digimon with a heart as cold as ice. It is said to be the evolved form of a Devimon with an especially cruel heart among other Devimon. As it specializes in deceiving the enemy with its way of words, it wraps them up in its ice wings and freezes them.

A Fallen Angel Digimon whose body is clad in jet-black cloth. Although it was originally a shining Angemon-species Digimon, by falling to the Dark Area, which exists in a spatial distortion of the Digital World, it became a fallen angel. As proof of that, the Mark of Evil surfaced dramatically on its chest. It has a cunning and fiendish personality, but it also possesses an outstanding intellect. It is said that those who have stared into its two eyes, are mind-controlled and completely dominated by Devimon.

A Beast Man Digimon that evolved from Terriermon and is a Hunter Digimon skilled in hunting. Despite its outward appearance, it uses attacks of unparalleled accuracy and its nimble movements to reliably bring down the opponent. Its leg strength is strong enough for it to jump sky high, and it is also able to spread out its ears to glide. Although it usually has a cheerful personality, it gets out of hand once it is angered. It is obsessed with its cherished ''D-VI'S 503xx'' jeans.

An Angel Digimon whose body is clad in cloth so pure white as to be divine. It is a being of perfected virtue, and although it is called a Digimon that brings happiness, when confronting evil it does not stop attacking, with extreme composure, until the opponent is completely annihilated. On the countless times when the Digital World is visited by a crisis, it is told that it descends to lead Digimon of the same genus, and Devimon, which was won over to the Dark Side, was originally of the same species.

An advanced Demon Man Digimon that came from the Digital World of another dimension. In its native Digital World (Witchelny) it mastered the sorcery (high-level programming language) of fire and earth, and although it aimed to become a great wizard, it appeared in the Digimon World in order to train. Although it has a personality that likes playing a few practical jokes, because it has another, shyer side, it tries to never show its uncovered face.

A Bewitching Beast Digimon in the shape of a giant fox with nine tails. Although it is feared as a bewitching beast that brings about destruction and ruin, in ancient times, it was revered as a messenger that appeared in times of peace. It is said that even among Renamon, only those with the most outstanding abilities and who have amassed the most experience can evolve into Kyubimon. It is said to even be able to sprint across the sky with its four feet blazing with blue flames.

There is a will in the blade on its tail, and it has become possible for it to cope even with attacks that surprise it from behind. However, it isn't suited for mutual communication, and it has been seen quarreling with its tail in the middle of battle. It prefers to fight within forests, and it skillfully employs its claws and tail to easily climb trees, so close attention is necessary when fighting Reppamon in the forest.

It has a very healthy curiosity, so it loves pranks. Although its body is small, it is a precious Holy-species Digimon, and its appearance does not match the true strength it possesses. It wears a Holy Ring on its tail, proof that it is a Holy-species, but if this Holy Ring is lost, its power is decreased and it can no longer exhibit its original power. In order to defend itself, it wears long claws copied from Saber Leomon's data.

A Digimon whose form resembles that of the Oni from Eastern legends. Although it has high intelligence, it has a violent temperament, and there is no limit to the destruction that it brings about with 'anger' acting as its driving force. Due to its intense love for battle, it will boldly challenge even opponents that greatly surpass it in combat ability, earning it the name ''Digimon Hunter''. The Hone Konbou it wields in its right arm was earned from defeating Skull Greymon in battle.

A Champion Digimon whose appearance resembles a chrysalis. In order to evolve into a stronger Digimon, the Rookie-level Keramon entered a chrysalis-like state and began conserving its energy. As a result, it is completely unable to move, but it is protected by its tough shell, and can attack the opponent with the tentacles extending from its back. In some cases, it can evolve to Ultimate without becoming a Champion, but it is able to evolve to a stronger Ultimate by evolving to Chrysalimon.

A Virus attribute Garurumon. The blades extending from its shoulders are so sharp that they slice apart anything they touch. It loves collecting bones and burying them in the ground, though there appear to have been cases of these bones being quietly stolen away by prank-loving Drimogemon.

A Mollusk Digimon which possesses a slug-like body. It prefers dark, gloomy environments, and has neither offensive power nor intelligence. A Digimon becomes a Numemon if mistakes are made in raising it, but as a matter of fact, there appears to be some hidden secret...In order to defend itself against intruders, it uses a disgusting attack in which it throws its own poop.
A Digimon shrouded in black flames. Due to the roughness of its temperament, for which it continues counterattacks against enemies to a ferocious degree, it's difficult to even approach it.

An extremely unusual Insect Digimon with a humanoid form. It possesses nimble movements and a tough exoskeleton, defining traits of Insect Digimon. It excels in its abilities as an assassin, aiming for the opponent's vitals with its nimble movements and keen judgment, and specializes in attacks that silence the opponent with a single blow. It is highly intelligent and has great composure, along with a cool disposition.

Coredramon's Dragon-factor data has reached 100%, so it is undoubtedly a pure-blooded Dragon Digimon. The blue-skinned Coredramon is said to be the evolved form of a Dracomon that ingested large quantities of a rare gem called ''Blue Diamante'', which is mined only in mountainous regions with very high altitudes, and is able to fly at high speed with its developed wings to survive in the steep mountains.

Coredramon's Dragon-factor data has reached 100%, so it is undoubtedly a pure-blooded Dragon Digimon. The green-skinned Coredramon is said to be the evolved form of a Dracomon that ingested large quantities of a rare gem called ''Green Malachite'', which is mined in dense woodland with trees over a century old. Although this type of Coredramon is not good at flying, it has highly developed leg strength, allowing it to run at speeds that are unimaginable from its physique.

A martial artist Digimon discovered in the back regions of a Chinese mountain province. It wanders the world in pursuit of its arch-enemies, viruses that do evil through email. It has the making of an exceptional kenpo practitioner, but it still lacks training. It uses the Togaken style it invented itself, and its finishing move Ninja Fist is a nimble stealth attack making use of its jumping power.

Lopmon underwent a ''Dark Evolution'' due to anger and hatred, becoming a brutal Beast Man Digimon. It is not completely ''evil'', and deep within its heart it possesses the gentle side it had while it was Lopmon. However, its ''warmth'' can be broken by the power of its anger, so that it runs the whole gamut of destruction. Also, it has the ability to manipulate time and space, and is able to warp by passing through other dimensions, as well as to create a special space.

A Beast Digimon that resulted as Gaomon's physique got larger, its claws that were once protected by gloves have grown steadily. Although it is a quadruped, with its tenacious leg strength it can also stand up to attack like a bear.

A Beast Man Digimon which is called the ''King of Beasts''. While most Digimon are savage, it possesses a strong purpose and a heart of justice, and has defeated a great number of fiendish Digimon. Also, it is a rival to the ''Digimon Hunter'' Orgemon, who runs the whole gamut of destruction. Its tough flesh, tempered well by daily training, can endure any attack, and it chokes the life out of the opponent with its ultimate secret technique, its Special Move ''Fist of the Beast King''.

It is called the ''Great Eagle of the Desert'', and as it flies through the sky at Mach speed, it possesses the eye strength to locate the opponent from a very great distance. The horns on its head, when it glides from a great height and charges the opponent, exhibit an immense might. Although there are many Bird-species Digimon with brutal personalities, Aquilamon respects decorum, and unconditionally abides by the orders given by the master it has pledged allegiance to.

Covered in blue, white, and silver-colored fur, it is a Beast Digimon with an appearance resembling a wolf. That fur is as hard as ''Mithril'', which is said to be a legendary rare metal, and since the blades growing from the tips of its shoulders have sharp edges, anything that touches them is cut to pieces. As it possesses a furious combat instinct and muscles honed in freezing lands, as well as carnivore-like agility and the accuracy to reliably bring down its targets, it is a being feared by other Digimon.

A ferocious Beast Dragon Digimon that possesses the disposition of a beast and a dragon, it is such a heavyweight that most Digimon run away just at the sight of its shadow. Although it exhibits that ferocity of a wild beast when it comes to battles, it also has the intelligence of a dragon, and is usually very docile. Because it has an old-style Interface on its brow, it is presumed to be an evolution of a ''Prototype Digimon''.

An Undead Digimon of the Prototype Digimon ''DORU Series'' that was experimented on in search of further evolutions, and was said to, at the time of the experiment, resemble its Adult form. By continuously preying on the Digicores of other Digimon, it is active despite its deceased condition, and is attempting to evolve.

A Hunter Digimon that was originally a Virus Digimon, but was converted to a Vaccine by a mutation. Similarly to Snimon, it is a brutal Digimon that exists solely to hunt Virus Digimon despite being a Vaccine, and it can't be controlled by an ordinary Tamer.

A Bird Digimon with powerful leg strength, such that it would be faster for it to run than to fly in the air. Its Special Moves are jumping high into the air, rapidly spinning its entire body and pulverizing the enemy with its gigantic claws. Also, it specializes in a striking technique in which it pecks the enemy with its sharp beak like a woodpecker.

Because it has continued to live on the ground for so long, it cannot fly through the air, and has evolved a body that is suited for land. For that reason, its body became even larger, and its leg strength has developed tremendously, as well. Parts of its wings have completely degenerated, and in battle, it spreads them wide with its tail to intimidate the opponent. Its disposition is violently ferocious, but in order to preserve its large build, it dislikes violent battles that consume its energy.
A variation of V-dramon whose body has been turned a deep red. It is said that V-dramon evolves into this form when it reaches the peak of its anger.

A Giant Bird Digimon which has an appearance shrouded in blazing flames. Just like Meramon, it is a Digimon that was generated from the Internet's defensive ''Firewall''. It flaps its gigantic wings, and flies about the sky. Although its personality is in no way combative, it unleashes counterattacks against attacking enemies to a furious degree.

An Insect Digimon armed with gigantic pincers on its head. Like Kabuterimon, it has combat abilities that far exceed those of similar species that inhabit File Island. It is protected by its tenacious power and sturdy shell, and in particular, as the power of its pincers is super-powerful, once it clamps an enemy it will squeeze until the opponent's life is extinguished. There is a perfect rivalry between it and the Vaccine-attribute Kabuterimon, and there is only ''Conflict'' between them.
A Digimon whose body is made of ice. Whether it is an evolution or a mutation of Gotsumon is still a mystery, and research continues to be done on that matter.

The strongest Cyborg Digimon, which has mechanized more than half of its body. Going through numerous battles, it was able to survive by mechanizing its body. In order to evolve to MetalGreymon, it must fight its way through and defeat the formidable opponents who come against it. Also, MetalGreymon's offensive power is said to equal that of a single nuclear warhead. It fires missiles from the hatch on part of its chest.

A Cyborg Digimon which has mechanized more than half of its body. The MetalGreymon of File Island were able to drastically extend their vital functions through remodeling, but their flesh portions could not hold out and were discolored blue. However, perfect MetalGreymon are Cyborg Digimon that succeed in evolving from Greymon, and draw out a stronger power.

A Skeleton Digimon whose whole body has become nothing but bones. It was a Digimon that put too much importance on fighting, and as a result of its combat instinct it clung to life despite its body rotting away, becoming SkullGreymon. As SkullGreymon doesn't have even a scrap of intelligence to balance its combat instinct, its existence is a threat to other Digimon.

A Cyborg Digimon that remodeled its body in order to acquire mightier powers. After Megadramon was remodeled for anti-air use, MetalTyranomon was remodeled as an anti-ground interceptor Digimon. Its reinforced body deflects all attacks, and it possesses the terrifying offensive power to smash through armor with its sturdy chin, no matter how hard it may be.

A Cyborg Digimon that has mechanized over half of its body. In spite of its large build, it flies to the sky to attack the enemy. The offensive power of the shots fired from the gigantic revolver on its left arm is said to rival that of a single nuclear warhead, and it is normally impossible to rapid-fire due to its tremendous power and recoil. In order to withstand that power, its gun barrel is made from Chrome Digizoid.

It is a Cyborg-type Perfect Digimon. Its body has grown gigantic, and its upper body has been metallized with the super-metal, ''Chrome Digizoid''. It is able to take flight with the two vernier attached to its shoulders, so it is possible for it to perform both anti-air and anti-ground attacks. In order to restrain it from running wild due to excess power, a restraining tool similar to a bit is attached to its jaw section.

A Dinosaur Digimon that evolved from a Tyranomon that overcame many fierce battles. The scars covering its body act as proof of the numerous battles it has survived. It takes on a master-like role, coaching its Tyranomon followers and raising them to become full-fledged warriors.

An unidentified Digimon that suddenly appeared in the Digital World. It calls itself the ''King of Digimon'', and its fighting strength is beyond imagination. And, well, it's rumored that it pulls the strings of the mysterious Monzaemon. It is dressed in its reinforced Saru Suit which can endure every attack, and even today it bustles about the whole world for the sake of its unending battles.

The space warrior Starmon turned into this Perfect level Mutation Digimon. It raised its self-satisfaction and clothed itself in a flashy outfit, making its debut as a star. Although it means to use its sunglasses as a disguise to conceal its superstar identity, they do not help at all.

A colossal Beast Dragon Digimon whose form was released through the Interface on its brow by the potent life-force data of the legendary beast, the ''Dragon'', which slept within the deepest parts of its Digicore. With its overwhelming stature it can demolish any dauntlessly courageous Digimon, and even the attacks of the ''Nightmare Soldiers'' are deflected with one sweep of its wing. It is highly intelligent, and won't reveal its existence carelessly, so it is difficult to even detect it.

An Ankylosaur Digimon with a huge horn. It is thought to be the evolved form of Monochromon that live near volcanoes, and its armor-like skin, which is as hard as a diamond, is resistant to heat from volcanoes.

Seadramon-species that survived the harsh environment of the Folder Continent area evolved into this form, in order to outlive others in the Digital World. Its body became a size larger, the carapace covering its head got harder, and a lightning-shaped blade has grown on its calvaria. Its intelligence has developed more than the Seadramon-species, so it chases its opponent persistently, like a seeking torpedo, and reliably brings them down.

Living in the deep oceans of the Net, it is a Digimon of large build. Due to that enormity, it carries a volume of data that couldn't be processed by a normal computer. Although it has been possible to confirm it as the same species as those in File Island's coastal waters, this Whamon, which lives off of Folder Continent's coast, and whose appearance is totally the same, has surpassed the previous in both offensive ability and vitality, and accomplished an evolution to Ultimate.

A bipedal Ceratopsian Digimon with the appearance of the Triceratops, whose offensive ability competes for first or second among herbivorous dinosaur types. The sturdiness of its skin is top class among organic Digimon. The two horns growing from its brow are super-sturdy, just like its skin, and are far harder than that of Monochromon. Its ordinarily sluggish movements belie the offensive power of its charging attacks, which are capable of obliterating even the sturdy-bodied Mineral-species Digimon.

It further guards its well-tempered muscles with protectors, which it made from the pelt and shell that it stole from its opponents. The horn on its head has been replaced with one that became impossible to regrow, so it voluntarily processed it into a saw shape. However, after all is said and done, its strongest weapon, which it dug up from ancient ice, is its ''Thor Hammer'' made of Chrome Digizoid.

An Archangel Digimon with the appearance of a beautiful woman. Although it was previously classified as an Angel-type, it was confirmed as an Archangel-type because of the greatness of its abilities. Although its personality is extremely gentle, it cannot forgive those who are crooked or evil, and it won't stay its hand from attacking until the opponent converts. Because of its soul and power, it is said to be a being like a goddess of the Digital World.

A Reaper-like Digimon holding a gigantic sickle and chain. It is a higher class of Ghost Digimon compared to Bakemon, so when a person is possessed by Fantomon they are in their last moments, and it comes upon them when they die completely.
