The Mega form of Eosmon born when a researcher lost control after things didn't go as expected, fusing multitudes of Eosmon into a single being. Eosmon (Mega) runs amok, following a sole instruction: eliminate all obstacles. New Ultimate Eosmon are produced from its bulging tail, allowing it to increase its subordinates.

One of the many existing subspecies of Agumon. This variant seems to possess a natural ''battle spirit'', granting it great fight skills. For some reason, this subspecies of Agumon have a deeper connection with the Royal Knight known as Omegamon. It is uncertain why, but scientists believe that it has to do with how its DigiCore was programmed.

One of the many existing subspecies of Agumon. This is one of many Digimon variants that possess a natural ''battle spirit''. This Digimon is said to appear when there is an abundance of other Agumon. Its reddish color helps it stand out, preventing it from being confused with other individuals.

One of the many existing Agumon subspecies. This one has a cyan coloration and deep purple eyes. This seems to be a species born only to fight. There are reports of this subspecies facing opponents of much higher levels and holding their own in the fight, even if with some difficulty. It is said that the most skilled were even seen winning such fights against formidable opponents.

Although it is impossible to prove, it is believed that this blue-skinned subspecies evolved from Agumon (Black) rather than the regular Agumon. This hypothesis is based on the aggressive behavior that these individuals present, in addition to the ability to expel greenish flames, just like Agumon (Black).

A tiny familiar Digimon which has the appearance of a bat. This purple subspecies is known to be the errand boy of a certain Demon Lord. It serves to report any important news to its master. Because of that, it can constantly be seen carrying a tiny camera on its back.

A Digimon whose power over fire exceeds that of legend due to the unknown powers it obtained by fully inheriting the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Aldamon is a Demon God who transforms fear and anger into a righteous power to fight. Its violent behavior earns it many enemies, but its name reflects the fused form of the wildness of a beast with the intelligence of a man. In battle, it unleashes attacks over incredibly large areas, melting and burning everything to a crisp.

A transcendent Digimon with power over flame, said to even surpass the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. The power of the nine dragon veins flowing through Gaia resides in KaiserGreymon's body. It has been prophesied that if it can harness that power, it will demonstrate unfathomable ability and rule over Gaia. It wields the Ryuugonken, a sword with the souls of dragons sealed within, in order to control this power.

The form taken by Gaioumon defeated in battle, obtaining new power after unimaginable training. The ogre data sleeping within its DigiCore has awakened, changing its fighting style to one using a single sword. Having mastered the Tenrin sword style passed down through the eastern Digital World, Gaioumon: Itto Mode specializes in ''silent'' swordplay that cuts down its foes instantly and soundlessly. Once Gaiomon is in its fighting stance, none can approach without putting themselves at risk.

A veteran warrior who evolved with a heart consumed by darkness. Legends say that this blue-black mythical dragon exhibits even greater ferocity than a regular AeroV-dramon, however it's existence is so rare nowadays that its existence is becoming nothing more than a myth.

A Digimon that possesses power over Ice, however it's correlation to the Ten Legendary Warriors is uncertain. It styles itself as holding the Gold rank as a member of a polar army's polar region defense force, which is reinforced by the yellow colors of its uniform. Because of that, it supposedly exerts command over the other Chackmon, however since it always says everything about this matter is classified information, it is likely Chackmon's own fabrication.

A Puppet Digimon that has been forgotten for a long time. Due to being left aside for too long, its skin has accumulated bacteria and fungi, which have made this Digimon grimy and yellowish. The mysterious eye that once shone within it now seems to have solidified into a green gem. As a result of this forced way of life, this subspecies of WaruMonzaemon has become even more cruel and depressed then its regular counterpart.

A Dragon Man Digimon that only a few Paledramon are said to be capable of Digivolving into. Its icy exterior has developed further, transforming into a kind of armor that covers its entire body. This greatly increases its offensive and defensive capabilities. Thanks to the pillars of ice that extend from its wings, it is now able to maintain its form unchanged, even when facing Digimon that give off incredible heat.

A legendary Magic Knight Digimon that only those who master ice magic are said to be able to Digivolve into. Rumor has it that Hexeblaumon helped protect other Digimon while the Digital World was in the midst of an ice age, then traveled to the extradimensional world of Witchelny. Skilled at techniques that involve manipulating cold, Hexeblaumon can create a variety of things from ice. These range from weapons like swords and hammers to restraints meant to hinder an enemy's movement and even barriers to protect itself.

An eccentric Digimon that acquired a still unknow power due to a mysterious form of DigiXros. It's Digimon Suit changed color from a faded white to a shine gold thanks to the Omega InForce, although it can only use it while doing gags. The sharpness from its previous form can be seen not only on its color, but also on the sharp X bandage in its umbilical hernia.##*Speculative name. This Digimon has no known official name.

A Digimon specializing in dogfights, soaring soundlessly through the skies at high speeds. Speed is not Sparrowmon's only weapon, however. Its tight turning radius offers the maneuverability necessary to execute sudden turns without effort. Fundamentally moody and excitable, its flight style changes based on its mood. When Sparrowmon performs difficult aerial acrobatics without being asked, this is undeniable proof of its high spirits.

It was born when waste data drifting through the Digital World combined randomly. Its favorite phrase is ''No good, no good!'' and it has the unfortunate habit of criticizing everyone around it, regardless of the time or place. Though Damemon is perhaps best described with its own phrase, it somehow manages to get by with the help of its partner Tyutyumon. It's only with Tyutyumon's help that Damemon can even manage to function as a halfway decent Digimon.

Shoutmon (King) is a gallant form of Shoutmon with a yellow scarf that flutters in the wind. Its strength has increased by leaps and bounds thanks to its training, and it stands out all the more in its performances with its McField-brand microphone.

This unusual Digimon is the result of a DigiXros between a powerful Shoutmon and a MetalTyranomon. MetalShoutmon specializes in the musical style known as Heavy Metal, and its unique feature is the ability to transform its guttural vocals into pure energy. Some say it sings its music at the highest possible pitch so that everyone can hear the scream of its soul. Others, however, say it is simply screaming for no apparent reason. The truth is still unknown.

This unusual Digimon is the result of a DigiXros between a GigaBreakdramon and a Damemon. Being the fusion of a Digimon known for being the most destructive, and a Digimon born from trash data, it is uncertain if GigaBreakDamemon still possesses its former destructive power. Some say it seems to be totally weak, but the truth is still to be discovered. Even in this larger and more imposing form, its favorite phrase is still ''No good, no good!'' and it secretly keeps its unfortunate habit of criticizing everyone around it.

This unusual Digimon is the result of a DigiXros between a Patamon and a Sparrowmon. Despite its small size, this Digimon soars with divine precision across the skies, combining its inherited holy powers with unmatched maneuverability. Its movements reflect not only its mood but also its deep sense of justice.##*Speculative name. This Digimon has no known official name.

A Digimon that defies all expectations. The result of the unlikely DigiXros between Ogremon and Mervamon. The disconcerting combination of its youthful appearance and monstrous head creates a presence that oscillates between the absurd and the exotic. Many Digimon hesitate to face it. Not out of fear, but because of the strangeness and aura of imbalance that it emanates.#*Speculative name. This Digimon has no known official name.

A Pixie Digimon clad in vegetal armor, BloomLordmon is a kind-hearted knight that fights to protect nature. The flowers on its shoulders allow it to absorb energy from sunlight, which it stores for use in battle. When its energy stores are full, BloomLordmon's powers are said to rival those of the Royal Knights'. What's more, its ability to bring sun to the stormiest of weather means it always has the upper hand when fighting outdoors.

A spider-shaped Rookie Digimon that moves in tandem with Dokugumon. KoDokugumon is usually gentle, rolling up into a ball and hanging from tree branches and the like. But when enemies approach, it will drop down from above with its brethren to attack. It can't produce strong poison yet, and so wears gloves that inject strong poison from claws at the tips.

An artificial Digimon created by filling a unique rubber body with energy stolen from other Digimon. Troopmon is like a machine that simply carries out orders with no capacity to act on its own. It is also tireless, immune to pain, unafraid of death, and doesn't require sleep. It is essentially a fighting machine. Troopmon tend to act in groups, and while the combat ability of each individual isn't very high, their sheer numbers when they charge forward in a wave combined with their combat familiarity make them a force to be reckoned with.

A Lion-type Digimon that closely resembles MadLeomon, though it exhibits several distinct differences such as a much lighter-colored mane and a preference for wielding daggers as their weapon of choice. MachLeomon serves as the commander of a certain evil army and is known for its ruthless leadership and cunning in battle. While it shares the same cruel and savage personality as MadLeomon, MachLeomon's combat tactics emphasize speed and precision over sheer power.

A legendary Beast Man Digimon with golden fur. Many sightings of Apemon have been reported in the central Asian region of the Network, but no actual evidence of its existence has yet been found. Since it's extremely rare and reportedly excels at defeating malicious computer viruses, some humans consider it to be a mythical Digimon. It is also said to travel at extremely high speed within the Network by riding on some sort of cloud or puff of smoke.

A colossal Beast Man Digimon that is the ultimate form of MadLeomon, becoming the pinnacle of berserk evolution. While its massive frame suggests brute force alone, it defies expectations with astonishing speed and feral agility. Compared to its prior forms, its savage instincts have grown even more uncontrollable, turning it into a living embodiment of destruction.

A Demon Beast Digimon born from the DigiXros of a MadLeomon and an Orochimon, resulting in a massive beast with snake heads for limbs and tail. It is said that this Digimon has first appeared when a desperate MadLeomon was defeated in battle by its enemies and was forced to absorb data from an Orochimon in order to overcome those who defeated it. However, it is not known whether it succeeded or not.

A Beast Digimon that was deceived into consuming a forbidden hallucinogenic mushroom. Though this granted it immense power, said mushroom also infected its data, twisting its mind and driving it into madness. This corrupted form emits a sickly sweet stench, described by others as ''rotten garbage''. With its sanity devoured by the fungus, it has become a tragic puppet, doomed to serve the ambitions of its masters until the last scrap of its data is consumed.

A rare, corrupted subspecies of MadLeomon: Armed Mode whose body has turned a chilling blue, said to be the result of extensive self-inflicted mechanical modifications that gradually corroded its data. While it shares many traits with its standard counterpart, this version is noticeably more aggressive and volatile, its corrupted enhancements pushing it to more reckless and destructive behavior. It is feared even among Virus Digimon for its unpredictable outbursts and unrelenting thirst for combat.

A gigantic Digimon, made of what appears to be snow, that bears the alias of ''Great Yeti''. Odd little mouths can be seen on its back, but their true function is unknown. Its origin is surrounded in mystery, but it seems to be tied to a long lost Chinese Digital World called ''Shenzou'', that can be accessed by the Jiuzhaigou Forest.

A Slime Digimon with a perpetual glower that always seems to be glaring at something. Though quite young, Keemon hates buddying up with others, and lives its life in hiding. It prefers poking its nose into the affairs of others from its hiding place, using Pushū to pester them with a paint-laden water cannon fired from its mouth.

A Lesser Digimon Digivolved from Keemon. It has turned into quite the contrarian as Yaamon. When it stumbles upon Digimon playing happily, it spits a Paint Splash from its mouth to cover them in ink. Yarmon enjoys seeing how Digimon are stunned by this act.

It has a very healthy curiosity, so it loves pranks. Unlike most Tailmon, this one does not possess a Holy Ring. This appears to be the reason why this Digimon possesses only a fraction of the power it would normally have. In order to defend itself, it wears long claws copied from SaberLeomon's data.

A Beast Digimon resembling a calico cat. Latent Nyaromon data in Mikemon's Rookie form manifests itself when the Digimon achieves Champion form. Mikemon is not a Holy Beast Digimon, however, and it lacks a Holy Ring. A clever Digimon, it is normally quiet and docile. In battle, however, it toys with foes using agile movements and special melee techniques.

A Dinosaur Digimon that resides in a strange land, created by a powerful Warrior Digimon of Norse mythology. It displays even higher levels of ferocity than a regular Allomon, and because of this, it is seen forming smaller hunting groups, consisting of only two or three individuals. It is not known for certain whether this Digimon exists outside of the reality created by said Warrior Digimon.

A Toucanmon that came from a long lost digital server that has recently reappeared. Even though its shell seems worn by time, its beak has clearly more vivid colors. It is unclear whether the color variations in this Digimon are caused by different rendering settings, or if it is a different species.

A Mutant Digimon that has the attribute of Plant. This dark colored variant is often seen in commanding positions, serving as both a warrior and an adviser. It is uncertain if this Digimon has any relation to the Digimental of Sincerity.

An In-Training Digimon characterized by its single horn and the large frill extending from the top of its head. Curimon is a highly active Digimon, and will bounce around in its Digi-Egg before even being born. Once it hatches, it's always on the move, like a little ball of energy. Since its horn and its frill are still soft and undeveloped, it can't use them in battle, but they're still useful when it comes to maintaining its balance and helping it bounce back from crashing into things.

An In-Training Digimon with two horns on its forehead that grew from Curimon. Gurimon bounds around in search of big, sturdy-looking boulders. When it finds one, it uses its signature move Prickly Attack to crash into the stone with its horns. Should the boulder withstand the attack, Gurimon will be overjoyed, running around in a sudden burst of energy in hopes of growing even stronger.

An extremely rare, young white Ceratopsian Digimon that was recently discovered. Gammamon's Digivolution is said to be related to a digital signal that came from somewhere outside our galaxy. The two sturdy horns growing from its head are weapons for both attack and defense. Gammamon uses the small wings on its back to float, allowing it to fly a little. It rarely shows emotion, but it seems to grow friendly over time once it establishes an emotional bond.

The matured form of Gammamon, its body turned red from the flames of its burning soul. BetelGammamon is more agile, and boasts improved speed and power in close combat. The strength of its attacks multiplies in accordance with the swelling of its emotions.

The Champion form of Gammamon, a quadruped with a magnanimous heart and imposing mentality. Firearms pepper WezenGammamon's body; it shoots the two horns on its head as long-range artillery, the horn on its nose as an anti-aircraft gun, and four small autocannons on its legs. Its movement speed is usually slow.

The matured form of Gammamon, its body turned blue from the tranquility of its serene soul. KausGammamon spreads the membranes on its arms to float like a glider. It will fly far distances from high elevations, using the jets on its knees to raise its elevation once during its flight. It is calm and collected at all times, and fights while reading its opponent's movements.

The evil heart hidden within Gammamon was unleashed, Digivolving it into a violent Digimon. GulusGammamon rejects outside interference and thinks of nothing but battle. When it gets its hands on the opponent in front of it, it will continue its assault until their life is extinguished. Its battles are brutal, and even if its limbs are crushed, it still continues attacking without concern.

A Sky Dragon Digimon with large, majestic wings turned a pure white by the ferocity of the roaring flames in its heart. Canoweissmon prefers honorable battles, be they in power or in speed. Its delight in combat increases the fiercer the battle becomes. However, Canoweissmon tolerates no acts of duplicity and will oppose them by enforcing its sense of righteousness. When Canoweissmon releases all of its power, its entire body shines with white-hot light so intense that it can be perceived in other dimensions.

An Evil Dragon Digimon that plots to rule through rage and fear. As an Ultimate-level Digimon, Regulusmon boasts power reminiscent of Megidramon of the famed Four Great Dragons, and its advent alone spells disaster. Its body is the source of the ''GRB'' (Gulus Realm Burst) contagion, and it is said that Digimon infected by the GRB factor undergo a twisted change in personality and run amok.

A Mega Dragon Man Digimon belonging to the righteous order called the Virus Busters. Wielding the Sylvia, twin cannons equipped on its arms, Siriusmon crashes in like a shooting star to defeat its enemies after hearing a voice calling for help from far, far, away or sensing evil. However, Siriusmon's kind heart is such that it is willing to put its weapons down and open its heart to an opponent in the middle of battle if it senses the possibility of reforming them.

A mysterious Digimon that supposedly Digivolves via evil, dark energy concentrated to extreme levels. During research into Digimon that can secrete the so-called GRB Contagion, simulations of injecting enormous amounts of the contagion into such a Digimon resulted in this ''theoretically'' possible Digivolution. The simulation was repeated hundreds of times, and all resulted in this Digimon. Researchers theorize that, under suitable conditions, Arcturusmon could actually manifest in the Digital World.

A Digimon that Digivolved by absorbing data about the music and fashion of punk rock culture. It is aggressive and rebellious in nature, as if it were the personification of punk rock anarchy. Rarely listening to what others say, Punkmon is an anarchist at heart who hates being ordered around and following others. Fond of fighting with flair, it will do anything to bring excitement to the battlefield, even if it means taking an attack on purpose to show off its opponent's moves.

A Digimon with a ferocious personality characteristic of carnivorous beasts. It is at the same level as Guilmon in terms of parameters. The wild nature of a Virus attribute Digimon shows more strongly in it compared to Guilmon.

A Dark Dragon Digimon known as the ''Jet-Black Dark Dragon''. Basically the same species as Growlmon, BlackGrowlmon has a stronger Virus type disposition, and is said to be Growlmon's original form. Unlike a Growlmon raised by a Tamer, it should be considered almost entirely feral. Just like Growlmon, its roar is mighty enough to shake the ground, and BlackGrowlmon uses it as an aggressive display to intimidate the enemy before battle.

A Growlmon that's turned orange as a result of becoming a Data type. Although Growlmon (Orange) tends to be more calmer than its Virus type counterpart, it is quick to fly into a rage if anything goes wrong.

A Digimon that Digivolved by absorbing data from various types of musical equipment and violent rock music. The armor covering its body is equipped with various functions, such as speakers that amplify the sound taken in from its chest microphone, and an effector that alters its voice. Its main speakers deploy during battle, allowing it to sing at an extremely high volume. As they will be exposed to the loud and raucous noise emanating from its body, any who oppose Loudmon are unable to perform at their best.

BlackWarGrowlmon is an Ultimate Android Digimon that Digivolved from BlackGrowlmon. Like BlackGrowlmon, BlackWarGrowlmon fiercely expresses its nature as a Virus type, and it's also known as the Black Destroyer Dragon. The upper half of its body is made of super-metal Chrome Digizoid, and it can fly thanks to the two vernier thrusters on its shoulders. It also has a freely extensible cord-like object that extends from its back which can double as a weapon to pierce foes.

WarGrowlmon (Orange) is an Android Digimon that Digivolved from the Data type of Growlmon. Armored in super-metal Chrome Digizoid, it also has anti-air capabilities thanks to its two vernier thrusters.

A Digimon that Digivolved into the form of an intimidating dragon by absorbing heavy metal culture. It thinks of its battles as a ''show'' and has a competitive nature that makes it seek out powerful opponents that can further excite an audience. It may even venture into the Dark Area in search of more thrilling battles, which is rife with evil creatures. HeavyMetaldramon's body is covered in Black Digizoid that clangs with the sound of metal against metal whenever it moves, and its guitar-shaped wings emit a deafening roar.

A heavyweight Digimon with a thick metal shell and overwhelming power. It appears belligerent at first glance, but Ballistamon's gentle personality favors peace over conflict, and it never attacks of its own accord. Even so, if a fight breaks out it becomes a champion of unparalleled power, swinging around its strong arms to eradicate foes. Its heavy armor and incredible power offer high potential for both offense and defense.

Ballistamon's Enhanced Armor Mode excels in defense. By housing another Digimon inside of it, it confers that Digimon power and defense several times greater than usual. Fusing the potential of both Digimon gives it access to many powerful special moves. Shoutmon X2's wide range of special moves lets it handle combat against single opponents or groups, including melee attacks, beam attacks, and live ammunition. These moves draw out an ample amount of Ballistamon's latent ability.

An Armor Pixie Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digimental of Kindness. Capricious by nature, Pucchiemon loves having its head rubbed as much as it enjoys gossiping, and often sings when in a good mood. It hates having its tail touched, however; if you try to force it, Pucchiemon's mood will sour and it won't listen to a word you say. While hardly strong, it possesses the mysterious ability to calm its opponents.

An Armor Pixie Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digimental of Kindness. Capricious by nature, Pucchiemon (Green) loves having its head rubbed as much as it enjoys gossiping, and often sings when in a good mood. It hates having its tail touched, however, and if you try to force it, this Digimon's mood will sour and it won't listen to a word you say. This green variant of Pucchiemon is quite rare, so it is very valuable.

BlackGalgomon is a type of Galgomon that excels at hiding in shadows and ambushing foes. Specializing in hand-to-hand combat, it also uses superior fighting techniques and has a higher degree of combat prowess than Gargomon. It has a remarkably cool personality, and is known for finishing its opponents with unerring strikes. Also, parts of its body have been coated in Black Digitron, providing it with increased defensive capabilities.

BlackRapidmon is a black version of Rapidmon that has become capable of fighting at night after ingesting Black Digitron. While it's lost some of its speed, it's also gained the ability to move without making a sound. Still capable of tracking enemies with its radar ears, BlackRapidmon excels at fighting in the dark, making it exceptionally difficult to defeat in a battle at night.

A type of MegaGargomon equipped with a massive amount of weapons to assault enemy territory. BlackSaintGargomon lacks speed, but uses the heat-based ordnance all over its body to counter attacks from all directions without taking a single step.

A highly social Digimon that's always ready to give its all. Chibickmon loves to imitate others and lend a helping hand. If there's a task you're trying to accomplish, large numbers of them may suddenly show up out of nowhere to help you. Since they generally don't understand the purpose of any given task, however, what they consider helpful may be no more than a nuisance. To make matters worse, if you ignore them or hurt their feelings they're quick to burst into tears, only adding to the distraction.

Starmon has a cheerful and attention-seeking personality, and is an extraordinary optimist to boot. It never gets depressed, and even its rare moments of discouragement are filled with thoughts of how cool it looks when it's down. Other Digimon view Starmon as silly because of this trait, but it doesn't mind in the least.

''Starmons'' is a unit comprised of a Starmon flanked by several Pickmon. The entire squad moves to the beat of the leader Starmon's drum. The leader's decisions are absolute, and the subordinate Pickmon move with perfect coordination in accordance to Starmon's commands. This harsh pecking order allows it to use group attacks like Meteor Shower and Wish Upon A Star, both of which require complex movements.

ShootingStarmon is the Jogress form of a Starmon and a group of Pickmon. It is the result of several Pickmon gathering around a Starmon and, in an effort of shared will, propelling that Starmon to the level of a Super Major Digimon.

A Mega Beast Man Digimon that rules over the icy peaks of the highest mountains. It is said that this subspecies of Vikemon inhabits the ''Snow Mountain'', a frozen region located in the North Sector of a certain Server from the Digital World. Although it has been sighted in Snow Mountain, apart from its combat techniques, which are more focused on raw power, much about this Digimon still remains a mystery.

A Carnivorous Plant Digimon with long vines and a gaping maw. This fiendish brute emits a sweet smell from its mouth to lure in smaller Digimon, then ensnares them with its long, tentacle-like vines. Still, Vegiemon lacks any offensive power, making it no match for large-scale Digimon. When Vegiemon grows, it will flower and bear fruit.

An enormous Pumpkinmon that rides a giant pumpkin, making it appear even larger. This Digimon is said to appear during Halloween to enjoy the festivities. Despite its playful appearance, it is a powerful attacker that should not be underestimated. However, despite all the strength this Digimon possesses, it prefers to spend its time enjoying Halloween rather than fighting.

The Mega form of Pumpkinmon, now dressed in more gentlemanly attire. NoblePumpkinmon has stayed true to the path of mediation, walking the fine line between justice and evil. Its only goal is to bring a smile to the face of each and every Digimon. With its cheerful personality and occasionally playful behavior, other Digimon are quick to open up to it, and no Digimon is ever cruel to NoblePumpkinmon. The staff in its hand, the Assam Ring Jack, can create pumpkin-based dishes delicious enough to satisfy anyone.

A Ghost Digimon made up of cursed virus programs. This version of Bakemon incorporated the data of magicians that appear in fantasy, and its black hat bolsters its magic power. This makes its curse and magic attacks devastatingly strong.

A Digimon resembling a witch, who pursued its rival Wizardmon from Witchelny, the Digital World of another dimension. Witchmon mastered wind and water magic (advanced programming languages) in its hometown of Witchelny, but it pursued Wizardmon to the Digital World and trains vigorously in order to get a leg up on a rival who aims to become a great sage. It has a bit of a cruel streak, more than a bit of pride, and loathes both convention and established routines.

A Digimon whose body is mostly made up of rock data. It lacks emotion, and acts as ordered. On certain occasion, a bulkier version of Rockmon will be born when it is created by unifying data fragments from important places in the Digital World, such as the Tree of Knowledge.

A Puppet Digimon that hides inside a stuffed animal shaped like Tyranomon. Why exactly this mysterious Digimon chose a stuffed Tyranomon is unclear, but it probably just hid inside whatever stuffed animal was nearby. Whatever the explanation, this stuffed Tyranomon has all the offensive and defensive power of Monzaemon, meaning no ordinary Digimon can stand up to it. However, it's also similar to Monzaemon in that it's little more than a doorstop without someone to control it.
A special Falcomon that emerged from a keychain game. Although it is without a doubt a subspecies of Falcomon, its potential abilities are unknown.
A special Agumon that emerged from a keychain game. Although it is without a doubt a subspecies of Agumon, its potential abilities are unknown.

An ambitious Android Digimon that rules over the ''Royal Base'' as its queen and is always seeking to expand the size and scope of its base. With high prowess in both science and engineering, it was responsible for the design and development of the Royal Base. It can manage defensive positioning and combat formations all by itself. On the other hand, it is inferior to TigerVespamon in regards to its capabilities in single combat. That difference is compensated for by its secret weapon, the Royal Throne.

A small Digimon which looks like a chick. It's still physically weak and isn't suitable for an actual fight, but even though it's a Baby II Digimon, we can see how it'll turn out to be after evolving.

A Chick Digimon that evolved via data related to samurai. It works hard training day and night, developing secret fencing in order to master swordsmanship. Although it shows confidence in its sword abilities, it still lacks merit. It is said that once Hyokomon has undergone repeated sword training and is able to break out of its shell, it will be the moment of its next evolution.

A Bird Man Digimon that evolved after continuous sword training. At the end of its training, it acquired enough skill to freely wield two swords. It is on a training pilgrimage, wandering across the Digital World while working as a bodyguard, relying on its honed sword abilities. It is rumored to take any job for a reward, and is often treated as an outlaw. However, it actually has a kind nature that never forgets its spirit of helping the weak, and will never take jobs that torment the weak.

A God Man Digimon clad in crimson armor, wielding a greatsword, it evolves from Digimon who have honed their sword abilities through repeated battles. Despite being an Ultimate, it is an expert who has already mastered swordsmanship. Possessing sword techniques that even feel beautiful and such incredible strength that is said to shatter mountains, the way it runs across the battlefield with its greatsword in hand is truly a statement for someone worth a thousand warriors.

A God Man Digimon that is also said to be a materialization of the system that governs time. The flow of time in the Digital World is truly vague, and disturbances in space-time occasionally occur due to conflicts between powerful Digimon or cataclysms. It is Chronomon who appears on those occasions, tasked with restoring space-time. Once it restores space-time, the fact that it manifested also disappears along with the space-time disturbance, so no one has seen Chronomon.

The berserk form of Chronomon. It is a legendary monster that is said to have abandoned its role of preserving the peace of space-time, and risen in revolt against the system that governs time. While it was restoring space-time, the various forms of malice in the Digital World flowed into Chronomon all at once, corroding it like a virus, and causing it to run wild. By abusing the power of time that Chronomon originally possessed, it hacks into memories engraved into the Digital World and then goes on a rampage.
A special Digimon that emerged as a reward in a certain campaign. Even though it has many similarities with Agumon, its potential abilities are unknown.

A pure-blooded Dragon Digimon that seems to be even older than its regular counterpart. This greenish Dracomon was found very deep in the net and it is origin is unclear. It possesses physical ability to a degree that could not be imagined from its small build.

A Mutant Digimon capable of freely traveling to and from Digital Worlds of other dimensions. Its objective shrouded in mystery, this fiendish existence devours the data of Digimon that inhabit the worlds it travels to. Parallelmon emerges out of nowhere like a phantom, and the great chaos and confusion it wreaks has led research teams to classify its appearance as a natural disaster.

A gigantic Vegetation Digimon that primarily settles in swamps. Hydramon excretes a deadly poison from every part of its body, which it mercilessly uses on prey to liquefy and then eat it. It also spews out large amounts of the same toxic substance from its chest, turning the earth into swampland, extending its territory. Such swamps warp the surrounding flora and fauna, so be on the lookout for Hydramon if you run across an area with mutated and twisted plant life.

A noble-minded, bloodsucking wolf Digimon. Sangloupmon is a considerably old species of Digimon said to have survived since the dawn of the Digital World. Digimon who have their blood sucked by Sangloupmon have all the information drained from their DigiCores, making them unable to maintain vital activity and ending their life. Sangloupmon disassembles its own data into packets and sends them across the Net, letting it teleport to other locations.

A bloodsucking martial artist Digimon that performs a magnificent dance. Born from a certain museum's folk dance database, Matadrmon is a master of the unique Bulldog dance. Its fluttering garments serve to deceive its foes, and it attacks those who let their guard down with the countless rapiers hidden in the folds of its sleeves. Matadrmon sustains itself by sucking Digimon blood, but not just any will do. It wanders from land to land in search of strong Digimon to feed upon.

GrandDracumon is a Dark Beast Digimon known as the king of all vampire Digimon. It has long maintained its own castle in the Dark Area, and is said to boast such overwhelming power that not even the Seven Great Demon Lords dare to interfere with it. Between its gentlemanly demeanor and the magical glamor in its voice, GrandDracumon can be devilishly charming, and there are numerous tales of Angel Digimon sent to destroy it that it then lured to the dark side.

An infantry Digimon of the D-Brigade. This mechanized brigade is a special forces unit composed of Dragon Cyborg Digimon, committed to missions kept secret from the public at all costs. Commandramon's skin has been modified with a special texture that detects surrounding colors in real time, allowing it to display all sorts of camouflage. Thus, most of Commandramon's targets end up in the ground without realizing it exists.

A heavy infantry Digimon of the D-Brigade. It is said that many of the 100 Commandramon who don't pass the special screening exam Selection-D will Digivolve into Hi-Commandramon. Its main role is to act as a shield, protecting the Commandramon assault troops with its massive build and protective armor. Like Commandramon, its skin has been modified with a special texture that detects and displays surrounding colors in real time.

A Holy Knight Digimon that is acknowledged even by the other Royal Knights as their foremost strategist. This Leopard Mode is the form Duftmon takes when entering the battlefield. In this form, Duftmon can attack with high-speed ground and air attacks.

Dominimon does not answer in any way to the angelic chain of command, and instead acts on its own. A rare type that suddenly manifests via mutation when the balance between the light and darkness of the Digital World is disrupted, Dominimon is almost never sighted. Valuing all life as a collective over any single entity, Dominimon does not consider its own life especially important. In order to escape a tricky situation, it will perform a death-defying attack without hesitation.

A unique species of Chaosdramon said to be the leader of an organization called Blood Knights. Its existence is surrounded in mystery and its exact location can only be found by those who are able to defeat the Three Chaos Generals and collect their Chaos Rings. It claims to be the most powerful Digimon, and it believes that all living beings strive to reach the peak of evolution by winning multiple battles.

An Armor Mammal Digimon that has Digivolved with the Digi-Egg of Hope. Sheepmon's body is covered in wool of the finest quality. It also moves very sluggishly. Just observing a flock of these Digimon moving will put anyone to sleep. The booster/bazooka unit on its back is called a Wool Ball Booster. This equipment reproduces the low-speed movement characteristic of Sheepmon.

A Digimon with power over darkness that bears the might of the Ten Legendary Warriors. Duskmon is the embodiment of an immense dark energy formed from the vengeful will of various types of extinct Digimon as well as Forbidden Data on the Net. Just as dark energy exists as the counterpart of the holy force of light, Duskmon is the antithesis of those who possess holy power. Unmatched in contests of swordsmanship, Duskmon never hesitates to resort to underhanded attacks.

It is said that only a Commandramon that passes the Selection-D exam is capable of Digivolving into Sealsdramon. This is no mean feat, as the Selection-D exam is a special test that involves screening 100 Commandramon until only one remains. Sealsdramon can move at speeds practically impossible to follow with the naked eye, and is strong enough to finish off its targets using only hand-to-hand combat, never relying on guns or camouflage techniques. Most of its missions consist of assassinations.

Pusumon is a Slime Digimon covered in fur as soft as cotton. Only the yellow hairs sticking out of its forehead are even somewhat hard. It gets anxious if it doesn't have its pacifier with it at all times, and will cry loudly and constantly if its binky ever goes missing. When threatened, Pusumon will take a deep breath to puff itself up, then blow out all that air to send its pacifier flying in an attempt to intimidate foes.

A quadrupedal Lesser Digimon with yellow spikes growing from its back. Pusurimon is always running around, full of energy. Every now and then it will appear to stop dead in its tracks, but this is just due to it falling asleep.

Herissmon is a Digimon brimming with curiosity, and will often focus on whatever has just caught its interest to the exclusion of everything else. Despite this, it's also extremely cautious, and if it ever feels threatened it will extend its hard, needle-like quills and curl up into a ball until the danger has passed. Once it's opened up to someone, though, it is quick to become close friends with them, and will happily show off its favorite treasures, which it keeps hidden among its quills.

A Beast Man Digimon with countless large quills growing from its body. Filmon's red claws can pierce through anything, and its yellow quills pour energy into whatever they stab. It gathers up comfortable nest materials while seeking out its favorite foods in a laid-back manner.

Only a small number of Filmon can temper their quills to their limits, achieving this Ultimate form. The quills all over Stefilmon are said to rival Red Digizoid in their sturdiness, acting as both a shield around its body and pikes boasting unparalleled attack strengths. The Hurricane Knuckles on its arms are its pride and joy, highly condensing its shed fur to form weapons. It trains diligently, dreaming of the day it can trade blows with its perceived rival, WereGarurumon.

Rasenmon's true form, achieved by accepting its negative emotions without fear and regaining the courage to believe in itself. Severing the shackles of negativity, Rasenmon has gained full control of its rampaging power in this form, and its brutal disposition has calmed into a kind, gentle nature. In battle, it can accumulate more power by absorbing the emotions of its allies as energy, and only makes use of said power for actions it believes are just.

A brutal, nine-tailed Mega Digimon that took in large quantities of negative emotion data when it Digivolved from its Ultimate form, losing the ability to control its dark power. Once it finished Digivolving, Rasenmon gave itself over to the rampaging power of darkness, becoming an avatar of destruction that impulsively devastates the surrounding area. Its brutal personality is the result of the destructive impulses born from painful conflict, as it fears and rejects the negative emotions swirling within itself.

This is the form Sakuyamon takes on when performing Shinto rituals in accordance with the will of the gods. Sakuyamon rarely fights while in Miko Mode, but it is more skilled in warding off evil in this form.

Kuzuhamon: Miko Mode is the form Kuzuhamon takes on when performing Shinto rituals in accordance with the will of the gods. Kuzuhamon rarely fights while in Miko Mode, but it is more skilled in warding off evil in this form.

A Beast Digimon with a strong spirit of chivalry. Dorulumon can mostly be found in rocky, mountainous terrain, where it typically acts independently rather than in groups. The drill on its head is made of its own hardened hair, and its Drill Buster attack, by which it spins this drill at high speed before shooting it at an enemy, never misses. It specializes in hit-and-run tactics, running around at high speed to flush out and then attack enemies before moving out of reach.

A cat-shaped Puppet Digimon that flies around the Net Ocean. TobuCatmon has a wild disposition and a love of the sea. The F-14 mark engraved on its body proves this Digimon is a fighter, despite its appearance. A mere 1% of its brethren are referred to as ''Cat Gun'', and are respected as powerful warriors. It can fold its wings to fly at high speeds, but has the habit of flashing the claws on its right leg when turning right, and the claws on its left leg when turning left; thus, the enemy can sometimes read its movements.

A Beast Man Digimon sometimes referred to as the goddess of cats. With an ostentatious but sly personality, Bastemon excels at using the many gems that adorn its body and the alluring flash of its eyes to beguile and then manipulate its foes. It can charm most of the creatures it meets, wrapping them around its little finger. Bastemon's graceful movements are a testament to its exceptional agility, but despite its slender frame it's also quite strong, and the claws on its hands can slice through large boulders.

Although the differences are not many compared to its regular counterpart, this Bastemon possesses extreme physical strength, capable of facing even Mega-level opponents. It uses its Helter Skelter ability to devolve any high-level Digimon in order to gain an advantage in battle. It is known that this subspecies of Bastemon lives on a server in the Digital World known as the Asuka Server, however it is uncertain where it can be found. All that is known is that some individuals are said to partner up with strong Tamers.

A Slime Digimon with soft fur all over its body. Highly curious in nature, this Digimon loves to move around. However, it gets tired very easily, and spends most of its time asleep. When danger draws near, they let out Puppy Noise, a high-pitched warning cry.

A Lesser Digimon with soft fur all over its body. It is curious about everything it sees, and has a habit of sniffing whatever has captured its interest. Although a very active Digimon, it often falls over when running due to its short legs. It is unable to ascend or descend a difference in elevation greater than the length of its legs, and has to roll itself around to move on surfaces with frequent variation in height.

A Dark Beast Digimon presumed to be an experimental ''Prototype Digimon'' from before Digimon were discovered due to the old-fashioned interface on its forehead. It is said that the deepest part of its DigiCore contains data from the warg of real-world mythology, which can be seen in its capacity for rage beyond that of a typical Rookie. Those who are deceived by its puppylike appearance and approach it without proper caution may find themselves on the receiving end of a vicious attack.

A Dark Beast Digimon with a body that generates enormous amounts of magic. The amount of magic it produces is so great that it constantly releases excess magic in the form of flames that pour out of its mouth. These flames are so powerful that Loogarmon can turn its surroundings to ash with a single roar. As the flames are born of magic, they burn for a long time. Those who fall victim to its burn are dealt a greater injury than they may have expected.

A Digimon that has succeeded in controlling the sinister magic data of a mythological warg that lay dormant in the deepest part of its Digicore. Program code written in a special language lines the inside of the armor covering its body. This suppresses its tremendous amount of magical power, which is converted into a tempest of flames, as if it were sealed magic. Soloogarmon can control the magical flames at will by manipulating the program code, using them to perform many different actions.

A Digimon in a chaotic state that has been inundated with an enormous amount of magical power. The sinister magic data of a mythological warg that lay dormant in the deepest part of its Digicore has been set free by the interface on its forehead. This vast amount of magical power is converted into flames which spew forth endlessly. The super-hot magical flames have burned their way through Helloogarmon, to the point that nearly its entire body has been replaced by fire.

An imaginary Digimon created from the daydream of a DigiCore. It is a Digimon that Digivolved through the interface on its forehead when its creative powers were miraculously unleashed. Perhaps because the DigiCore originally contained data from the warg of real-world mythology, its creation turned out to be an ''ultimate Dark Beast'' clad in silver armor and possessing an inexhaustible supply of magic. It has complete control of the blue magical flames that permeate its body.

One of the Four Sovereign Digimon that defend the Digital World. This protector of the West bears the attribute of steel. Having reigned since the era of myth, Baihumon is legendary like its kin, and its strength is said to rival even that of the gods. Although it is the youngest, Baihumon is still the most powerful of the Four Sovereign Digimon. Its immortality and immense power are supposedly born of its twelve DigiCores. Like the neutral Azulongmon, Baihumon is a being fundamentally devoid of allies.

A Beast Man Digimon that has the ability to control the wind. Yihumon is extremely brutal and cunning, brimming with malice by nature. It resides in Jakeizan, a vast and mountainous area of the continent in the eastern regions of the Digital World. It seldom emerges from those darkest peaks, home to many evil spirits. According to observation data, there is a high chance that this Digimon has existed since the earliest times, when the eastern regions of the Digital World emerged.

The form taken by BlackTailmon after absorbing large amounts of home delivery service data that has flowed into the Digital World over recent years. Its once-malicious personality gone, BlackTailmon Uver. will deliver packages entrusted to it with dedication, no matter what day it is. It is often spotted clinging to the back of its friend Pistmon to make its deliveries. The delivery bag on BlackGatomon Uver.'s back is in tip-top shape at all times, and can only be opened or closed by the Digimon itself.

An enhanced form of the strongest Digimon in the Digital World, with its body completely covered in red metal. It is said that this form is achieved after absorbing large amounts of energy. HiMugendramon's attacks possesses immense destructive power, however are slow and cumbersome, taking a while to charge.

Scorpiomon is an Insectoid Digimon also known as the Assassin of the Desert. It prefers to remain hidden, sneaking up on its prey from behind to stab them with the poisonous stinger at the end of its tail. Scorpiomon's venom is so deadly that it takes effect faster than a Digimon's nerve data can process, meaning Scorpiomon prey is killed before even realizing they were stabbed. Its ability to kill without ever alerting its prey to its presence is what has earned it the moniker of assassin.

A Slime Digimon still wearing the shell from its Digi-Egg on its head. It is laid-back in nature and makes a life for itself slipping into the nests of other Digimon. As the Digi-Egg shell acts as camouflage, Yolkmon is hardly ever spotted before it Digivolves.

A Mini Bird Digimon that goes about its activities while hiding within the luxuriant leaves of the forest trees. Its wings are undeveloped so it cannot yet fly, but it is agile enough to scamper up even vertical tree trunks.

A Bird Dragon Digimon that freely soars through the skies over vast woodlands. The horns on its head are soft organs that play much more of a sensory role than an offensive one. By reading wind currents with these horns, Pteromon can acutely perceive changes in climate. Pteromon is extremely curious about other kinds of creatures, and often thinks of ways to fly alongside and make contact with other Digimon. These include Rookie Digimon like Biyomon and Falcomon, as well as, sometimes, larger Champions and Ultimates.

A Bird Dragon Digimon with large wings and distinct, blade-like horns. Its hardened horns, further developed than those of Pteromon, grant Galemon a kind of sixth sense, allowing it to rapidly detect abnormalities in its surroundings through the winds they sense. An intelligent Digimon, Galemon can strike first by utilizing its ability to predict not only environmental changes, but threats such as enemy ambushes and attacks as well.

A massive Ultimate Digimon revered as king of the forest. The surface of the armor that covers even GrandGalemon's wings and beak has a magic coating. GrandGalemon possesses the special ability to reflect light and blend into its surroundings, and, despite their enormity, its wings can muffle sounds when flapped.GrandGalemon's large, comb-like protrusion symbolizes its status as king of the forest, and many of the forest's inhabitants are said to bow down at the mere sight of it.

A Mega Digimon known as the God of Wind, it embodies the data of the winds that blow across the Digital World. Zephagamon primarily dwells within forest regions, bringing with it warm winds that ripen the fruits of the trees. As such, it safeguards not only Digimon, but the environment itself as well. It is said that, in urgent situations, Zephagamon prevents disasters from happening by unleashing massive energy directly from the atmosphere via its exposed DigiCore.

A grave in which a Digimon who has passed away was laid to rest. It also acts as the final farewell to a beloved monster before its final departure. There is beauty to be found in the simplicity of its cross-shape.

A Virus-attribute Mythical Dragon Digimon that manipulates azure lightning to pierce evil. Just as XV-mon is considered the pure breed of V-dramon, this species of XV-mon is speculated to be the pure breed of V-dramon (Black), however there's no evidence to confirm this theory.
An extremely unusual Insectoid Digimon with a humanoid shape. It is a nimble sky assassin, protected by a super-hard body said to be even harder than regular Stingmon's exoskeleton.

An Otamamon mutation that acquired the attribute of flames. This attribute is the reason why Otamamon (Red) prefers hot springs instead of cold rivers. Like Otamamon, it loves to sing, and never skips out on vocal training. Its developed forelimbs are strong enough to clamber up rocks, and are powerful assets in battle.

A Digimon composed almost entire of earth data. Tuchidarumon is thought to be a mutant born from a mutation of Yukidarumon. It is friendly by nature and dislikes fighting, but when the chips are down it can demonstrate rarely seen power.

A Puppet Digimon that wears the leather of shoes and the skin of plush toys. If one attempts to touch Shoemon, it will swiftly hop away to escape. It is very cowardly in nature, and, via contact with the ground, acutely senses vibrations to quickly identify outside threats. The incredible grip of Shoemon's sole allows it to traverse the roughest of roads and climb even vertical walls and pillars without issue. Given Shoemon's preference for cleanliness, it dislikes walking in sandy areas or on muddy roads.

An agile Puppet Digimon who traverses as if gliding around on roller skates atop tree canopies. A restless Digimon, it dislikes staying still and is always in motion. ShoeShoemon typically stuffs its food into its cheek pouches, which have a far larger capacity than their appearance suggests. Besides food, it also places important items in these pouches to carry them around. ShoeShoemon also forces items that don't fit into its cheeks between the gaps in its tail or inside the zip pouch on its belly.

This Ultimate Digimon is an ornamental doll comprising data from fairy tales. Though Chaperomon is humanoid in appearance, its body is more similar to that of a doll's, meaning its joints can also bend in the wrong direction. Despite its demure appearance, Chaperomon actually hunts for sport and is quite hostile in nature. When hunting, Chaperomon stocks its basket with an arsenal of weaponry that it later unloads and utilizes to launch a variety of attacks on its prey.

A Mega Digimon born of data from the fairy tale ''Cinderella''. In contrast to its appearance, Cendrillmon inhabits volcanic regions. It lives a quiet life, in solitude and unseen by others, at the ''Ash-Coated Castle'', a base made from volcanic ash. When other Digimon visit its castle, however, it holds battle tournaments it calls ''Balls''. Cendrillmon holds these contests and engages in constant battles in search of a Digimon capable of defeating it, that it might proclaim this Digimon its ''Prince''.

The combination of three Digimon's instincts for conflict is what gave birth to this powerful warrior, Shoutmon X3, also known as Physical Mode. Its mind, body, and techniques are all top notch. Highly maneuverable, it manipulates foes with its acrobatic movements. Despite its delicate appearance, Shoutmon X3 is also good at withstanding shockwave attacks because its flexible joints are able to efficiently absorb and redistribute force. What's more, the V on its chest is a highly versatile weapon.

A Warrior Digimon extolled as the legendary hero of Witchelny, which is the Digital World of another dimension. Ancient Witchelny was on the path to ruin, since its magic (advanced programming language) was still in its infancy and it lacked techniques to protect the land from invasion by outside forces. It is said that MedievalDukemon suddenly appeared and repelled invaders, and that it transcends time to exist to the present day, although the truth is uncertain.

A spirit Digimon with a translucent body. Pafumon's body is downy and light, so it always drifts through the air. It tends to ride the wind to move, traveling quite a distance depending on which breeze it catches. This gentle soul has no love for conflict, but in a pinch Pafumon will use Puff Balloon, opening its mouth wide and sucking up air to inflate to triple its size. While the enemy is taken aback, it will seize the chance to escape by expelling this air.

A Lesser Digimon with a powerful tail. Inquisitive and curious about everything, Kyaromon tends to rush at anything that piques its interest. Its body is almost completely hollow, with the elasticity of a rubber ball. When it puts power into its Tail Swing attack, it packs enough of a punch to send even Rookie Digimon flying.

A Puppet Digimon whose cape flutters in the wind as it wanders gallantly throughout the Digital World. Although Nyabootmon might not seem very dignified due to its pompous speech and flamboyant gestures, it actually possesses a strong sense of justice and never condones any acts of evil. It practically zips through the air with its tall, gravity-manipulating boots as it journeys across the Digital World, and it relies on its trusty sword, the Catnip Rapier, to deal with any troubles it may encounter during its adventures.

Youkomon is a Mysterious Beast Digimon in the shape of a giant blue fox with nine tails. Unlike Kyubimon, Youkomon is feared as a strange beast that brings only destruction and decay. It lacks attack power, but possesses incredible spiritual energy and specializes in spells. The red flames burning on its limbs supposedly allow Youkomon to gallop through the heavens.
A bewitching subspecies of Kyubimon with silver fur who evolved into a Vaccine-attribute Digimon. Although it's less intelligent than Kyubimon, it seems to have excellent speed.

A Taoist Digimon that uses all the skills of faith to defeat opponents. Doumon is particularly talented at curses and charms. Like Taomon, Doumon usually resides in the dark, but unlike Taomon, Doumon specializes in death curses and assassination. Doumon can also change charms into familiars known as shikigami.
A Taomon enrobed in silver clothing and skin. An eerie mage who has awakened to the Vaccine-attribute.

A Bird Digimon with speakers built into its wings. Always alert for danger, Soundbirdmon is normally very quiet, but if it's ever approached by a Digimon it finds suspicious, it will shriek loudly to drive the intruder away.

The scattered form of Eyesmon. Eyesmon: Scatter Mode monitors social networking services streaming high volumes of data, devouring and storing the largest chunks. Although one of these Digimon is weak when alone due to fragmentation, they will reform into a single entity to counterattack in the face of danger.

A Digimon that can hide in shadow. Eyesmon grows stronger the more data it accumulates, surpassing even Ultimate-level power depending on the amount stored. Its countless eyes capture any and all movements of its enemies.

A demonic beast summoned from the Dark Area by the messenger of darkness Devimon, no Digimon comes close to this creature in terms of sheer wickedness. Devidramon has abnormally developed limbs for a Dramon-species Digimon. Evil incarnate, not an ounce of mercy resides in this creature's heart. Its four eyes burn a deep crimson; those caught in Devidramon's gaze seize up, allowing it to hew them to pieces without resistance.

A Digimon without substance, haunting the shadows of both man and Digimon. Shademon drinks the despair of those it possesses, feeding off of them. The amount of despair it consumes determines what kind of atrocious Digimon it will Digivolve into.

A Regular DigiTama. Despite the name, it is full of possibilities, as it contains data of almost all species of baby Digimon.
This means that any Digimon can hatch from this DigiTama, making each new journey unique and exciting.
A Dragon DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama have great raw power.
They are known for their brute strength and intense combat skills. A great choice if you are looking for a powerful and fearless partner!
A Beast DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are agile and fierce, with keen instincts.
They are ideal for those who appreciate brute strength combined with speed and tenacity.
An Insect DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are resilient and adaptable, but there are few high-level members.
However, they have unique abilities that can surprise their opponents. Perfect for those who value power and resistance.
A Holy DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are pure and have abilities capable of repelling darkness.
They are excellent for those looking for a partner who can easily destroy evil opponents with their targeted abilities.
A Bird DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are fast and graceful, with remarkable aerial abilities.
Although few, they are a great choice for those who prefer agility and mobility.
An Aquatic DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are adaptable to aquatic environments and have unique abilities in this type of field.
With some very powerful members, they are ideal for Tamers who like to build specific strategies.
A Machine DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are highly technological and their high resistance is their greatest power.
They are perfect for those who appreciate mechanical strength and good defense in battle.
A Dark DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama possess mysterious and often dubious abilities, capable of manipulating the fate of battle.
An intriguing choice for those looking for a partner with unpredictable and powerful abilities.
A Plant DigiTama. The Digimon born from this DigiTama are linked to nature and have the most diverse abilities.
Ideal for Tamers who want a partner who can easily inflict special conditions on opponents.
Um DigiTama comum. Apesar do nome, é repleto de possibilidades, pois contém dados de quase todas as espécies de Digimon bebês.
Isso significa que qualquer Digimon pode nascer deste DigiTama, tornando cada nova jornada única e emocionante.
Um DigiTama Dracônico. Os Digimon nascidos deste DigiTama possuem grande poder.
Eles são conhecidos por sua força bruta e intensas habilidades de combate. Uma ótima escolha se você procura um parceiro poderoso e destemido!
Um DigiTama Bestial. Os Digimon nascidos deste DigiTama são ágeis e ferozes, com instintos aguçados.
São ideais para quem aprecia a combinação de força bruta, velocidade e tenacidade.
Um DigiTama Insectóide. Os Digimon nascidos deste DigiTama são resilientes e adaptáveis, mas existem poucos membros de alto nível.
No entanto, possuem habilidades únicas que podem surpreender seus oponentes. Perfeitos para quem valoriza poder e resistência.
Um DigiTama Sagrado. Os Digimon nascidos deste DigiTama são puros e possuem habilidades capazes de repelir a escuridão.

This is where you can set up your Leader Skill set. Tamers can equip up to 3 Leader Skills to aid their Digimon partner in battle.
To do this, simply tap any available Leader Skill you want from the list here on the right side of the screen.
Once tapped, this side panel will show more information about the selected Leader Skill.

Tap any equipped Leader Skill in the lower left corner of the screen in order to unequip it.
Also keep in mind that some Leader Skills are incompatible with each other.
If you equip two or more RED Leader Skills, only one will be activated. The same goes for BLUE Leader Skills.

, need a little help with your equipment, huh?
A Digimon can hold at least one item that helps it during battle.
In order to do that, simply tap any available equipment in the list.
Once tapped, this side panel will show brief information about the selected equipment.
An ''Equip'' button will be displayed too. Tap it in order to give the selected equipment to your Digimon partner.
Keep an eye on the equipment requirements. Some require specific things before it can be given to your Digimon.
There are also some pieces of equipment known as ''Consumable Items''.
These can be equipped in the same way as normal equipment, but are single-use items. Once used, they'll be gone forever.
The equipped item will be displayed below your Digimon icon in the top left corner of the screen.
Tap the equipment icon below your Digimon to unequip it.

Find the best equipment for your Digimon partner and make it even stronger in battle!

Esses itens podem ser equipados da mesma forma que os equipamentos normais, mas são de uso único. Uma vez usados, eles desaparecerão para sempre.
O item equipado será exibido abaixo do ícone do seu Digimon, no canto superior esquerdo da tela.
Toque no equipamento abaixo do ícone do seu Digimon para desequipá-lo.

Encontre o melhor equipamento para o seu parceiro Digimon e torne-o ainda mais forte na batalha!
, precisa de uma ajudinha com a interface de Jogress, né?
Here is where the fusion process takes place. There are a few different types of fusion in the Digital World, but essentially they all work the same way.
There are a few steps you must follow in order to start.
First, tap any Digimon on the right side of the screen. This will be the base Digimon.
The base Digimon will determine the prerequisites for a fusion, such as required level, special XPs, which fusion chip will be used, etc.
You will note that a list of possible fusions will be shown at the bottom left part of the screen. Tap any of them in order to proceed.
Once you select a desired fusion, the requirements for said fusion will be shown on the left side of the screen.
The necessary Digimon for said fusion will be shown at the red/yellow boxes, at the top of the screen.
A fusion can require up to 9 Digimon, but most of them require 2 or 3.
Tap the necessary Digimon on the right side of the screen. This will add those Digimon to the fusion queue as material Digimon.
If you tapped a Digimon you don't want to use in the jogress, simply tap its icon at the top fusion queue, and it'll be removed.
Tapping the base Digimon will remove it, as well as all queued Digimon.
Once you have all the necessary material Digimon in the queue, the ''Jogress'' button will appear at the left side of the screen.
Tap it, and the Digivolution process will start!
It's important to mention that once fused, only the base Digimon will remain.
All material Digimon will be fused into it, thus deleting them as individual Digimon forever.
So always double-check which Digimon are you using in your fusions!
That's all I have stored in my Jogress help program. Now it's up to you,
Fusing 2 or more Digimon is a great way to improve their strength. Some are even capable of surpassing the Mega-level! Isn't that amazing!
, need a little help with the Jogress interface, huh?
É aqui que o processo de fusão ocorre. Existem alguns tipos diferentes de fusão no Mundo Digital, mas essencialmente todos funcionam da mesma maneira.
Existem alguns passos que você deve seguir para começar.
Primeiro, toque em qualquer Digimon no lado direito da tela. Este será o Digimon base.
O Digimon base determinará os pré-requisitos para uma fusão, como nível necessário, XPs especiais, qual chip de fusão será usado, etc.
Você notará que uma lista de fusões possíveis será exibida na parte inferior esquerda da tela. Toque em qualquer uma delas para prosseguir.
Após selecionar a fusão desejada, os requisitos para essa fusão serão exibidos no lado esquerdo da tela.
Os Digimon necessários para a fusão serão mostrados nas caixas vermelhas/amarelas, na parte superior da tela.
Uma fusão pode exigir até 9 Digimon, mas a maioria delas requer apenas 2 ou 3.
Toque nos Digimon necessários no lado direito da tela. Isso adicionará esses Digimon à fila de fusão como Digimon materiais.
Se você selecionou um Digimon que não deseja usar na fusão, basta tocar no ícone dele na fila de fusão superior e ele será removido.
Tocar no Digimon base o removerá, assim como todos os Digimon na fila.
Assim que você tiver todos os Digimon necessários na fila, o botão ''Jogress'' aparecerá no lado esquerdo da tela.
Toque nele e o processo de Digievolução começará!
É importante mencionar que, uma vez fundidos, apenas o Digimon base permanecerá.
Todos os Digimon materiais serão fundidos nele, deletando-os para sempre como Digimon individuais.
Portanto, sempre verifique duas vezes quais Digimon você está usando em suas fusões!
Isso é tudo que tenho armazenado no meu programa de ajuda sobre Jogress. Agora é com você,
